Mayflower is a technology company building large-scale entertainment products for a global audience. Our platforms serve millions of users worldwide and rank among the top-50 most visited websites globally. For more than 10 years, we've been creating reliable, high-performance solutions at the intersection of product, engineering, and entertainment.

As a Content Writer, you'll play a key role in keeping our Support & Moderation knowledge accurate, accessible, and up to date. You'll create and maintain internal documentation, identify knowledge gaps, communicate important updates, and improve content based on feedback. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, is comfortable working with ambiguity, and uses AI responsibly to improve efficiency without compromising quality.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain hundreds of content items across Support and Moderation, including knowledge base articles, process documentation, macros, bot replies, announcements, and internal guides.

  • Write clear, simple content for different audiences: agents, moderators, and customers.

  • Turn complex processes and rules into easy-to-understand documentation.

  • Keep the knowledge base well-organised, up to date, and easy to navigate.

  • Follow content standards for structure, terminology, formatting, and tone of voice.

  • Review content regularly to remove outdated, duplicate, unclear, or missing information.

  • Gather requirements from stakeholders and create accurate content based on business needs.

  • Build and continuously improve the content creation and maintenance process across Support and Moderation.

  • Use stakeholders' feedback, QC results, and business changes to drive continuous improvement of content.

Requirements

You will thrive if you have…

Must-haves

  • Strong English writing skills (C1+).

  • Experience in content writing, copywriting, knowledge management, content design, or similar.

  • Experience with Confluence or similar knowledge-base/documentation tools.

  • Experience using AI tools for writing, rewriting, summarising, structuring information, and content quality checks.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high volumes of content and manage repetitive writing/editing tasks without losing quality.

  • Ability to adapt content for different audiences: support agents, moderation specialists, internal teams, and end customers.

  • Understanding of tone of voice and ability to adapt wording based on context, topic sensitivity, and audience.

  • Strong attention to detail, consistency, terminology, and structure.

  • Ability to organise information logically, identify duplicated, outdated, conflicting, unclear, or missing content, and maintain documentation so it is easy to find, use, and update.

  • Ability to maintain naming conventions, labels, page hierarchy, templates, and version control.

Mindset and working style

  • Fast, practical, and execution-focused.

  • Comfortable working with large volumes of information.

  • Detail-oriented, but not perfectionistic.

  • Able to create a good version quickly, test it in practice, and improve based on feedback.

  • Understands digital users, online communication, and live entertainment context.

  • Supports company and team values in the way content is written and maintained.

  • Motivated by clarity, consistency, and usability.

  • Comfortable working remotely with a high level of ownership, transparency, and self-organisation.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Zendesk, Slack, chatbot tools, macro tools, or support platforms is a plus.

  • Experience in Support, Moderation, Customer Operations, or similar is a plus.

  • Experience with Jira, Asana, Monday, Notion, or other task/request management tools.

Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.

  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.

  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.

  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.

  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.

  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.

  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

Benefits are provided in accordance with the company's policies and eligibility criteria.

Recruitment process

  • Test Task

  • HR Interview

  • Final interview with Hiring Team

TÉRMINOS DE REFERENCIA

CONSULTORÍA PARA EL DESARROLLO DE UNA METODOLOGÍA DE FORMACIÓN DE FORMADORES SOBRE EL PROTOCOLO PARA LA INVESTIGACIÓN Y JUZGAMIENTO DE CASOS DE VIOLENCIA SEXUAL EN OAXACA

Título de la consultoría: Desarrollo de una metodología de formación de formadores sobre el Protocolo para la investigación y juzgamiento de casos de violencia sexual en Oaxaca, México

Unidad organizativa: Programas

Reporta a: Representante Regional para ALC y Associate Manager, ​Advocacy LAC

Ubicación: Remoto

Idiomas: Español

Fecha límite de solicitud: 2 de octubre de 2026

Duración: finales de octubre - finales de febrero

Honorarios de la consultoría: Fase 1: $3,000; Fase 2: $2,500 USD

SOBRE EQUALITY NOW:

Equality Now es una organización global de derechos humanos dedicada a lograr los cambios legales y sistémicos necesarios para poner fin a la discriminación contra todas las mujeres y niñas, en todo el mundo. Desde su fundación en 1992, ha contribuido a la reforma de 140 leyes discriminatorias a nivel global, impactando positivamente en la vida de cientos de millones de mujeres y niñas, así como en sus comunidades y países, tanto en el presente como para las generaciones futuras.

Trabajando con aliadas y aliados a nivel nacional, regional y global, Equality Now combina una profunda experiencia jurídica con una diversidad de perspectivas sociales, políticas y culturales para seguir liderando, orientando e impulsando los cambios necesarios para alcanzar una igualdad de género duradera, en beneficio de todas las personas. Para más información sobre Equality Now, visita.

OBJETIVOS:

Diseñar una metodología híbrida de Formación de Formadores (FdF) para aplicar el Protocolo para la investigación y juzgamiento de casos de violencia sexual, con enfoques de género, derechos humanos e interculturalidad. La metodología fortalecerá las capacidades de las personas operadoras de justicia de Oaxaca para replicar y adaptar la formación de manera autónoma y sostenible, mediante espacios de formación cruzada con otros actores clave.

ENTREGABLES:

Producto 1. Documento metodológico de Formación de Formadores

Propuesta pedagógica y operativa para formar a personas operadoras de justicia de Oaxaca en el Protocolo para la investigación y juzgamiento de casos de violencia sexual, con una duración de 16 a 24 horas en modalidad presencial, síncrona o asíncrona.

El documento incluirá objetivos y competencias; perfiles de participantes y personas formadoras; módulos, contenidos y actividades; criterios éticos y de autocuidado; evaluación del aprendizaje; seguimiento de la aplicación y réplica del Protocolo; y criterios para el pilotaje, validación y ajuste de la metodología.

La propuesta deberá contemplar tres componentes articulados:

  • Componente teórico-conceptual: apropiación y aplicación práctica de los contenidos técnicos y jurídicos del Protocolo, con énfasis en los estándares de derechos humanos y su aplicación en la investigación y juzgamiento de casos de violencia sexual.
  • Componente metodológico-pedagógico: desarrollo de competencias para la enseñanza de personas adultas en el ámbito jurídico, incluyendo estrategia de facilitación, uso de los recursos pedagógicos y manejo de situaciones que puedan surgir durante la formación.
  • Componente

    práctico

    de

    microenseñanza: ejercicios de simulación en los que los participantes pongan en práctica la facilitación de contenidos y actividades, con retroalimentación y evaluación de sus competencias técnicas y pedagógicas.

Producto 2. Caja de herramientas pedagógicas para la Formación de Formadores

Materiales editables y accesibles para implementar y replicar la formación, incluidos guías de facilitación, presentaciones, ejercicios, casos prácticos e instrumentos de evaluación, según corresponda.

Los materiales deberán facilitar la aplicación del Protocolo con enfoques de género, derechos humanos, interculturalidad e interseccionalidad, y criterios de confidencialidad y no revictimización. La caja de herramientas y el documento metodológico se ajustarán durante el pilotaje para entregar sus versiones finales.

Producto 3. Validación y pilotaje progresivo de la metodología y la Caja de Herramientas para la Formación de Formadores (ToT)

La persona consultora implementará, por etapas, un pilotaje de la Formación de Formadores con personas operadoras de justicia de Oaxaca, en coordinación con Equality Now y conforme al cronograma acordado. Equality Now facilitará el componente técnico y jurídico; la persona consultora estará a cargo de los componentes metodológicos, pedagógico y prácticos.

Durante el pilotaje, la persona consultora deberá:

  • Poner a prueba la metodología y los materiales desarrollados en los Productos 1 y 2.
  • Facilitar ejercicios de aplicación y microenseñanza para que las personas participantes practiquen cómo replicar la formación.
  • Observar y valorar sus competencias de facilitación mediante criterios definidos previamente.
  • Recoger y sistematizar la retroalimentación sobre la claridad, pertinencia y utilidad de la metodología y los materiales.
  • Identificar e incorporar los ajustes necesarios para facilitar la implementación y réplica de la formación.

Entregables:

  1. Informe breve de pilotaje y validación con los resultados, la retroalimentación recibida, las fortalezas y áreas de mejora identificadas, los ajustes realizados y las recomendaciones para futuras réplicas. La persona consultora presentará el informe en una reunión con el equipo de ALC.
  2. Versión final validada del documento metodológico y de la caja de herramientas, con los ajustes derivados del pilotaje y lista para su implementación y réplica.

La consultoría se llevará a cabo en dos fases:

Fase 1

octubre-diciembre 2026

  • Productos 1 y 2
  • Revisión y retroalimentación

Fase 2

Enero–febrero 2027

  • Validación del componente metodológico-pedagógico
  • Validación del componente práctico
  • Revisión y retroalimentación.
  • Versión final de la metodología y Caja de Herramientas para las formaciones híbridas/online.

El orden de los contenidos en este calendario está sujeto a modificación según las recomendaciones de la persona consultora.

PERFIL Y CUALIFICACIONES DE LA PERSONA CONSULTORA:

Formación académica y capacidades

  • Formación universitaria en ciencias jurídicas, ciencias sociales, educación, estudios de género, derechos humanos o áreas afines. Se valorará la formación especializada acreditada en violencia sexual, acceso a la justicia, derechos humanos, perspectiva de género, interculturalidad o educación de personas adultas.
  • Capacidad para analizar y sintetizar contenidos jurídicos y técnicos complejos y comunicarlos de forma clara, accesible y no discriminatoria.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, organizar el trabajo, coordinarse con equipos interdisciplinarios y cumplir con los productos y plazos establecidos en los TDR.

Experiencia y conocimientos técnicos

  • Al menos cinco años de experiencia profesional relevante en derechos humanos, igualdad de género, acceso a la justicia o reparación, particularmente en relación con la violencia basada en género o la violencia sexual.
  • Experiencia en el diseño, desarrollo y evaluación de procesos de Formación de Formadores (FdF) dirigidos a personas adultas, preferentemente a personas operadoras de justicia, al funcionariado público u a otros actores institucionales. Los procesos deberán contemplar la transferencia de conocimientos y el desarrollo de competencias para que las personas participantes puedan replicar la formación.
  • Experiencia en diseño instruccional y en metodologías de aprendizaje para personas adultas, con enfoques participativos y orientados a la aplicación práctica. Se valorará el uso de casos, simulaciones, ejercicios participativos y otras metodologías activas, en modalidades presenciales, virtuales o híbridas.
  • Experiencia en la elaboración de guías metodológicas, manuales, currículos, cajas de herramientas y otros materiales técnicos y pedagógicos que faciliten la implementación y la réplica de procesos formativos, con un lenguaje claro, accesible y no discriminatorio.
  • Conocimiento y aplicación de estándares nacionales e internacionales de derechos humanos relacionados con la violencia basada en género y la violencia sexual, en particular en materia de igualdad y no discriminación, debida diligencia, acceso a la justicia, derechos de niñas, niños, adolescentes y mujeres, protección de víctimas y sobrevivientes, y reparación integral.
  • Conocimiento del funcionamiento de los sistemas de procuración e impartición de justicia en casos de violencia sexual y violencia basada en género, incluidos los procesos de investigación y juzgamiento, los estándares probatorios, la actuación de las instituciones competentes y las medidas para prevenir la revictimización. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en el diseño, la implementación o la evaluación de protocolos, herramientas o capacitaciones dirigidos a personas operadoras de justicia.
  • Experiencia en la facilitación de procesos formativos y de espacios de intercambio entre distintos actores, incluidas instituciones públicas, fiscalías, poderes judiciales, organizaciones de mujeres y de la sociedad civil, y personas defensoras de derechos humanos. Deberá demostrar capacidad para conducir procesos participativos y abordar con cuidado situaciones sensibles relacionadas con la violencia sexual y las experiencias de victimización.
  • Experiencia en la incorporación de enfoques de género, derechos humanos e interculturalidad en procesos pedagógicos, adaptando los contenidos y las metodologías a los contextos, perfiles y necesidades de las personas participantes.

Conocimientos y experiencia deseable en el contexto de Oaxaca

Se valorará especialmente que la persona consultora cuente con:

  • Conocimiento del contexto sociocultural y territorial de Oaxaca, en particular de las condiciones y barreras que afectan el acceso a la justicia de mujeres, niñas y adolescentes sobrevivientes de violencia sexual.
  • Conocimiento de los sistemas normativos indígenas y comunitarios, así como de las dinámicas de articulación entre estos sistemas y el sistema estatal de justicia, desde un enfoque de derechos humanos e interculturalidad.

POSTULACIÓN:

Las personas interesadas deberán presentar:

  • Una breve carta de presentación en la que describan su experiencia relevante para la consultoría e incluyan enlaces a ejemplos de metodologías o materiales pedagógicos que hayan desarrollado.
  • Un cronograma de trabajo propuesto, que indique las principales actividades, etapas y tiempos previstos para el desarrollo de los productos, incluyendo los momentos de coordinación, validación y pilotaje.
  • Un currículum vitae (CV) que acredite la formación y la experiencia señaladas en el perfil requerido.

raw.title: Practice Lead, Growth
raw.excerpt: Build the Practice.  Scale the Teams.  Partner with Growth-Stage Operators.
raw.description:
Build the Practice. Scale the Teams. Partner with Growth-Stage Operators.
In 2008, Propeller reinvented the way venture-stage companies build finance teams, and in the process we defined the category the market now calls fractional. Three years ago, we quietly began building what comes next, expanding to serve our breakout clients as they scaled past venture and brought leadership in-house. That became our Growth practice: today it serves our largest clients and generates a third of Propeller's revenue. Now, with the practice staged to break out, we're hiring the leader who will professionalize and scale it.
You'll own the practice end to end: its commercial engine, its embedded delivery teams, and the strategic relationships that anchor it, bringing the horsepower Growth-stage Consumer companies need as they scale from $30M to $300M and beyond.
Growth-stage companies operate differently than venture-stage startups. The financial infrastructure is more complex. The operational stakes are higher. The boards are more demanding. The margin for error is smaller as companies approach exit velocity. And turnover in the finance seat stays high, because these companies accelerate faster than even exceptional talent can adapt. These clients need a CFO partner who has lived the $30M-to-$300M journey; someone who knows where the landmines are, how to build the systems that scale, and who has the career experience and confidence to make the case for uncomfortable truths when a situation requires it.
This is an equity-track leadership role for someone ready to build a practice, not just a portfolio.

Who We ARE
Today, Propeller's 250+ professionals serve as the embedded finance and accounting partner to some of the most iconic emerging companies in Consumer, Technology, Blockchain, and Business Services. All are full-time employees, across three continents; none are contractors or freelancers. Behind us: 1,500+ companies served, $105B+ in enterprise value created, 26 unicorn alumni, and $29B+ raised. Ahead of us: the transformation of professional services through AI-enabled intelligence.
Our embedded teams integrate seamlessly into client operations in multi-year partnerships. We attend weekly leadership meetings, participate in board prep, collaborate on strategic decisions, and have direct access to client CEOs and CFOs. This embedded positioning creates trust, access, and influence that traditional providers never achieve.
PropellerOS, our financial operating platform, combines human judgment, precision accounting, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled insight to transform finance from a back-office function into the central nervous system of growth. The system enables finance-grade standards of lineage, reconciliation, auditability, and explainability, with a named human accountable for every number we ship.

Key Responsibilities

Most leadership roles emphasize one dimension. This role requires three.
At $30M to $300M there is no bench to delegate to, so the finance leader architects the data systems, engineers the process change, and directs the AI that now carries the mechanical work, all at once. The market treats each of those as its own job. We built the infrastructure that makes them one: embedded access, AI fluency training, and dedicated change-management capacity behind every engagement.

Commercial Leader
You own the Growth practice's expansion: pipeline, bookings, retention, and P&L. You think like a business owner. You build relationships before you need them, identify opportunities others miss, and close deals that grow the practice. You develop go-to-market strategy for Growth-stage Consumer companies and build the private equity, investor and advisor relationships that generate referrals. Sixty-seven percent of our closed-won new business comes from referrals, so the network already produces; your job is to point it at Growth and extend it. If you wait for business development to hand you leads, this isn't your role.

Service Leader
You build the teams that carry our Growth portfolios: Controllers who each run their own client book. Controller and CFO are parallel tracks here, not rungs on one ladder, and part of your job is placement, putting people in the seat where their strengths compound. A brilliant controller running five clients flawlessly outranks a miscast CFO in every way that matters to a client. You set service standards and hold people accountable for client satisfaction, deliverable quality, and engagement profitability. You know that excellence at scale requires systems, not heroics. You conduct regular portfolio reviews, build capacity through hiring and development, and step in when engagements need senior attention. If you need to do everything yourself or avoid difficult management conversations, this isn't your role.

Strategic Partner
You serve as CFO-level advisor to Growth-stage Consumer operators, bringing the pattern recognition that only someone who has scaled companies from $30M to $300M can offer. You maintain strategic relationships with the most complex clients in the segment. You walk into boardrooms and command respect, translate financial data into strategic insight, and deliver difficult messages with clarity. You know where companies break as they grow: the systems that stop working, the hires that become urgent, the board dynamics that shift. The exposure compounds, too: across the portfolio you'll sit in more boardrooms in a quarter than most operating CFOs see in a year. And when an AI-produced analysis goes to a board, you are the one who certifies it and stands behind it in the room. If your experience is primarily early-stage or primarily enterprise, this isn't your role.
  • Drive business development through networking, referrals, strategic partnerships, and direct outreach.
  • Own financial performance of the Growth practice: revenue, margins, utilization, and profitability.
  • Lead and develop the practice's embedded teams, placing people in the seats where their strengths compound.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and escalation point for key accounts.
  • Participate in board meetings and investor conversations for strategic clients.
  • Make informed decisions about pricing, resource allocation, and engagement scope.
  • Use PropellerOS to deliver the cross-client insight no single-company CFO can access, and codify what works at Growth stage back into it so your judgment compounds for every client in the practice.
  • Continuously improve service delivery quality, efficiency, and client impact across the practice.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Demonstrated business development success: ability to identify, cultivate, and close client relationships in coordination with our GoToMarket team.
  • 15+ years in finance/accounting with at least 7 years in CFO or senior financial leadership roles.
  • Direct experience scaling companies from $30M to $300M+ in revenue, ideally as CFO or VP Finance.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: you work with AI in your own finance workflow today, and you can walk us through how it changes what you produce.
  • Track record leading and developing teams: managing managers, not just individual contributors.
  • Multi-client or consulting background strongly preferred (Big 4, boutique advisory, PE portfolio, or similar).
  • Strong executive presence; comfortable presenting to boards, private equity sponsors, and sophisticated stakeholders.
  • Experience building financial infrastructure that scales: ERP transitions, reporting systems, planning processes.

Industry Expertise
You understand how Consumer businesses work: the economics, the channels, the metrics, the seasonal rhythms, the retail relationships, the brand dynamics. Deep expertise in at least one of: DTC/e-commerce (CAC, LTV, channel economics, fulfillment optimization, Shopify/Amazon ecosystem); CPG (trade spend, retailer margins, inventory turns, COGS optimization, promotional ROI); or omnichannel retail (wholesale vs. DTC mix, sell-through rates, gross margin management, supply chain finance) along with experience in core processes and systems, such as inventory, trade spend, Quickbooks, Netsuite, etc. Business Services depth alongside Consumer is a plus.

Job Benefits

Job Title: Practice Leader, Growth
Location: Remote-flexible with occasional travel

DEI Statement: At Propeller Industries, we encourage our employees and our clients to bring their true selves to the organization. We believe that a diverse team enables us to cultivate and improve upon our culture of inclusion and collaboration. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome the contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran’s status, religion, disability, sexual orientation, and beliefs. So however you identify and whatever your background, we encourage you to apply for this role if you share our passion for helping great entrepreneurs build great companies. We look forward to meeting you!

Compensation
  • Base salary range $300,000 - $350,000 + significant variable compensation tied to practice performance and new business.
  • Equity participation.
  • Investment in your development: AI/automation training, executive coaching, and access to Propeller's network.
  • Remote-flexible with travel for client meetings, team leadership, and conferences

Current Benefits Offered: Generous Paid Time Off and Holiday pay, Comprehensive health benefits plus dental, vision, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. HSA contribution, Paid Family Leave, 401k match and Remote Work. We also help you grow in your professional life.

Technical Project Manager - MSP / IT Infrastructure

Remote - United States
$90,000-$95,000 + Benefits
Travel to Southern California / Los Angeles County for initial training and approximately 1-2 company visits per year

We are recruiting for a Technical Project Manager opportunity with an established managed IT services company that has been serving small and midsized businesses for more than 25 years.

This is a remote position focused on leading the successful delivery of IT infrastructure and software implementation projects across multiple client environments.

This is not a traditional non-technical project management position.

The ideal candidate will come from an MSP background and combine strong project leadership skills with significant hands-on infrastructure experience. You should be comfortable planning and coordinating projects while also understanding the underlying technology well enough to lead technical discussions, troubleshoot issues and perform implementation work when necessary.

This could be an excellent opportunity for an experienced MSP Project Engineer, Senior Systems Engineer or Infrastructure Engineer who has already been leading projects and is ready to move into a dedicated Technical Project Manager role.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own assigned IT projects from approved scope through planning, implementation, testing, documentation and final handoff

  • Translate scopes of work into detailed project plans with tasks, owners, dependencies, milestones, estimated effort and completion criteria

  • Manage multiple concurrent projects across different client environments

  • Lead infrastructure projects including server installations and upgrades, Active Directory migrations, Microsoft 365 implementations, Azure projects, virtualization projects, network upgrades, firewall deployments, workstation rollouts and disaster recovery initiatives

  • Coordinate technicians, engineers, vendors, client contacts and internal stakeholders throughout each project

  • Lead project kickoffs, technical working sessions, status meetings and completion reviews

  • Validate technical prerequisites including equipment, licensing, backups, access, documentation, maintenance windows and rollback plans

  • Track project scope, schedules, budgeted effort, dependencies, risks and resource requirements

  • Identify potential problems early and escalate technical or project-related blockers before they impact delivery

  • Provide hands-on technical implementation and troubleshooting when necessary

  • Perform structured testing and quality assurance before projects are considered complete

  • Maintain accurate technical and project documentation including configurations, diagrams, credentials, decisions, changes and test results

  • Ensure completed projects are handed off cleanly to ongoing support teams

  • Participate in post-project reviews and help improve project delivery processes

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience working for a Managed Service Provider (MSP)

  • Significant experience leading multiple concurrent IT infrastructure projects across different client environments

  • Strong hands-on Windows Server administration experience including server deployment and configuration

  • Strong Active Directory and Group Policy experience including domain controller deployment and domain administration

  • Strong Microsoft Azure administration experience

  • Strong networking experience including routers, switches, VLANs and firewalls

  • Experience configuring and deploying firewalls

  • Experience with virtualization technologies including Hyper-V and/or VMware ESXi

  • Experience with Microsoft 365 environments and migrations

  • Ability to take an approved scope of work and independently turn it into an organized, executable project plan

  • Strong understanding of project scheduling, resource coordination, risk management, change control, testing, documentation and operational handoff

  • Ability to coordinate technical resources effectively without necessarily having direct supervisory authority

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to make sound technical decisions during project implementation

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills

  • Ability to work independently with minimal oversight

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

  • HaloPSA

  • Kaseya

  • NinjaOne

  • Hudu

  • IT Glue

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This company has built an unusually stable team and client base over more than 25 years in business. They place a strong emphasis on employee retention, work-life balance, professional development and giving experienced employees the autonomy to do their jobs without constant micromanagement.

Additional highlights include:

  • Remote work

  • Very low employee turnover

  • Long-term client relationships

  • Mature processes, procedures and documentation

  • Dedicated 24/7/365 technical coverage, so this position is not the first responder for routine after-hours or holiday support incidents

  • Strong Help Desk and Support Desk teams

  • Significant autonomy and minimal micromanagement

  • Career development and advancement opportunities

  • Comprehensive benefits

Compensation and Location

The salary range for this position is $90,000-$95,000, depending on experience, plus a comprehensive benefits package.

This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States.

Candidates must be willing and able to travel to Southern California / Los Angeles County for initial training and approximately 1-2 times per year thereafter for company meetings or other business needs.

If you are an experienced MSP infrastructure professional who enjoys owning projects, coordinating resources and seeing technical implementations through from planning to successful completion, we would like to hear from you.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We are a boutique IT recruiting agency that strictly works with IT consulting companies and managed services providers. We place candidates on a permanent, full time basis (no contract or contract-to-hire positions).

raw.description:
Digital Forms is a consulting-led digital transformation firm, founded in Warsaw in 2015 and now 70+ people strong. We work with mid-market and enterprise clients across Europe, the UK, and the US — helping them turn operational complexity into measurable business outcomes. We started as a mobile development shop. Over ten years, we built something different: a firm where every product is grounded in a real business case, and where engineering quality is as important as strategy. Our team is fully remote, our clients are international, and our standards are high.

This role sits at the heart of that delivery.

As Senior Mobile Developer, you will be embedded in a high-stakes client engagement - building a greenfield mobile app for a premium international luxury retail brand, from the first architectural decision to launch.

The role and responsibilities:

We are building a brand-new iOS and Android app — from scratch — as part of a major digital transformation for a premium international luxury retail brand. The app will serve 250k+ daily active users across global markets from the moment it launches.

The product replaces static navigation with a dynamic, content-driven Feed ecosystem: personalised brand stories, exclusive offers, and live in-store updates, delivered with the engagement depth of social media. It is a greenfield project — no legacy code, no technical debt, full architectural ownership from day one. The app goes live in Q3.

As Senior Mobile Developer, you will own the architecture and delivery of the app end to end. You will write code every day — this is a pure hands-on engineering role, with no team management responsibility. The client expects senior autonomy from the start. You will work alongside a senior cross-functional team: backend engineers, frontend web developers, UI/UX designers, and a PM.

Architecture & technical leadership

  • Architect from scratch: Design the React Native app structure, patterns, and coding standards that the entire project will build on.

  • Define the content model: Work alongside FE Web developers to design the mobile content model powering dynamic, segmented delivery.

  • Drive technical decisions: Own integration choices for CMS, DAM, and personalisation tooling — and be able to defend them.

Feature development & integrations

  • Integrate CMS, DAM & personalisation: Connect the tooling that delivers the right content to the right user — context-aware, segmented, and real-time.

  • Implement deep linking: Build campaign-tied navigation flows and personalised user journeys across iOS and Android.

  • Ship push notifications: Design and implement the full push notification layer, including deep links and campaign landing flows.

  • Collaborate on features: Build and maintain new features together with backend engineers; work with UI/UX designers to assess feasibility and deliver high-quality UX.

Performance & quality

  • Optimise for scale: Own caching strategy, content-fetching architecture, and rendering performance for an app used by hundreds of thousands of people daily.

  • Instrument analytics: Implement event tracking that supports personalisation decisions, A/B testing, and experimentation.

  • Write quality code: Idiomatic, well-tested React Native — unit and component coverage as standard practice.

  • Own distribution: Manage iOS and Android release cycles and store submissions.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • React Native — 5+ years of professional experience building production iOS and Android apps from scratch.

  • iOS and Android platforms — both, including distribution cycles, store submissions, and platform-specific behaviour.

  • CMS & DAM integration — hands-on experience delivering dynamic, segmented content in mobile via headless CMS and DAM tooling.

  • Personalisation & experimentation platforms — integrating decisioning tools, recommendation engines, or A/B testing systems into a live mobile product.

  • Deep linking — production experience implementing campaign and personalised navigation flows.

  • Push notifications — full implementation including deep links and campaign flows.

  • REST API integration — connecting mobile apps to backend services at production scale.

  • Performance optimisation — caching, content-fetching, and rendering strategies for personalised, high-traffic apps.

  • Analytics & event tracking — instrumentation supporting personalisation and product experimentation.

  • Testable code — appropriate unit and component test coverage as standard practice.

  • English C1+ — written and spoken; direct communication with an international client team is a hard requirement.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with streaming APIs or AI-assisted feature integration.

  • App analytics platforms such as Firebase or Amplitude.

  • Consent management and third-party privacy tooling (GDPR).

  • Mapping SDKs — Google Maps, Mapbox, or similar.

  • Automated testing beyond unit and component level (E2E, integration).

  • Broader JS ecosystem: , React, .

  • A/B testing, feature flagging, and mobile attribution.

  • Headless CMS architectures in retail or e-commerce environments.

  • Understanding of UI/UX design principles and ability to assess feasibility.

  • Polish is a plus; all project communication is conducted in English.

Highlights

Build a brand-new mobile app for a premium luxury retail brand, used by 250k+ daily users.

Own the full architecture — React Native, CMS, DAM, personalisation — from day one.

Business Director: Capital One Shopping (Remote-Eligible)

About Capital One Shopping

Capital One Shopping is an industry-leading consumer technology business that is changing the way people buy and save online. The team operates with extreme focus to accelerate growth of the Shopping business, find best-in-market savings for shoppers, and create unique value for our merchant partners.

Technology and a rapid test-and-learn methodology are applied to nearly all of our business challenges. The team has a flat organizational structure that emphasizes clear ownership, small teams, and leverage through technology.

We are looking for a Business Director to join our team to improve and integrate new product and revenue opportunities with our merchant partners, and drive cross-functional execution within Shopping.This Business Director will have a demonstrated interest and aptitude for AI. While formal on-the-job experience with AI is a plus, we highly value candidates who have proactively incorporated AI into their personal projects, explored AI-driven development environments (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot), or built automations using AI agents. Show us how you've used AI to learn, build, and solve problems beyond basic text generation.

Summary:
As a Business Director at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You’ll team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

General Responsibilities:

  • Partnership:  Work closely with colleagues across Capital One including:  IT, Sales, Operations, Finance and others to drive improvement in quality, volume, service, and profitability

  • Strategic; analytic orientation: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the business is based on rigorous analytic marketing & credit risk management

  • Strong business judgment, leadership and integrity: They should be a tenacious decision maker, able to bring a healthy, aggressive, yet responsible approach to business

  • Solid people leadership experience: Ability to build and leverage the capabilities of a high-performing team, as well as business partners across the enterprise. They should foster innovation, drive critical decisions, hold business partners accountable, and be able to consistently deliver results

  • Strong executive communication skills: Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills

  • Clear results orientation: display an intense focus on achieving both short and long term goals. They should be able to drive and execute an agenda in an uncertain and fluid environment

  • Successful track record of thriving in a fast paced, entrepreneurial and dynamic environment. Previous consulting experience is a plus

  • At least 4 years of experience performing qualitative analysis

  • At least 2 years of experience performing people management

  • At least 2 years of experience performing project management

raw.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

★ PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR VIDEO PORTFOLIO OR REEL ★

Bilingual Video Editor (Spanish/English)

Location: Remote – Costa Rica
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Long-Term Independent Contractor
Number of Openings: 1 Position
Industry: Marketing & Advertising / Social Media & Content Creation
Compensation:$8.00 – $10.00 USD/hour
Experience:3+ Years of Professional Video Editing Experience
English Proficiency: Good Professional Working English Required
Spanish Proficiency: Fluent Spanish Required
Schedule: Flexible | Must have at least a few hours of weekday overlap with U.S. Central Time (CT)
Start Date: As Soon As Possible

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based creative content and social media agency that helps local businesses communicate their stories through video, photography, and social media content.

The agency works with businesses such as restaurants, community-focused organizations, and local brands, producing authentic content designed to build trust and strengthen their digital presence.

The team takes a storytelling-first approach to content creation, combining creative strategy with real footage and brand stories to produce social media content, branded videos, podcasts, and other digital assets.

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and dependable Bilingual Video Editor (Spanish/English) to join a small creative team as a long-term independent contractor.

You'll work remotely with footage captured by a U.S.-based production team and turn it into engaging content for clients every week.

The work will range from Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Facebook content to brand films, event recaps, customer stories, and a Spanish-language video podcast.

This is a hands-on editing role for someone who combines strong technical skills with good creative judgment, storytelling ability, organization, and reliable communication.

What You'll Do

Short-Form & Social Video Editing

  • Edit short-form vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, and other social platforms.
  • Transform raw footage into engaging, platform-ready social content.
  • Follow scripts, creative notes, and client-specific direction.
  • Adapt edits and exports to the requirements of each platform.
  • Handle revision rounds and incorporate feedback accurately.

Brand & Storytelling Content

  • Edit longer-form brand films, event recaps, and client story videos.
  • Build clear and engaging narratives from footage captured by the production team.
  • Maintain appropriate pacing, tone, and visual consistency based on each client's brand and audience.
  • Balance polished production with authentic, social-first storytelling.

Podcast Editing

  • Edit a Spanish-language video podcast.
  • Clean and balance audio.
  • Add captions, graphics, and other necessary visual elements.
  • Prepare final podcast content for distribution across appropriate digital platforms.

Post-Production

  • Perform color correction, audio mixing, captioning, and basic motion graphics.
  • Select and organize footage based on scripts and creative direction.
  • Ensure final deliverables meet technical and visual quality standards.
  • Export finished files in the appropriate formats and specifications.

File & Workflow Management

  • Keep project files and footage organized within shared storage systems.
  • Maintain clear file naming and version control.
  • Manage multiple editing assignments and deadlines.
  • Communicate proactively regarding project progress, questions, revisions, or potential delays.
  • Deliver projects consistently and on time.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong portfolio or reel demonstrating short-form social content and storytelling.
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Fluent Spanish, written and spoken.
  • Good professional working English, written and spoken.
  • Strong understanding of editing fundamentals, including pacing, storytelling, audio, captions, and visual flow.
  • Ability to perform basic color correction and audio mixing.
  • Ability to create simple motion graphics.
  • Strong organization and file-management skills.
  • Consistent communication and reliable, on-time delivery.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Own computer capable of efficiently handling 4K video footage.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection.
  • Availability for at least a few hours of weekday overlap with U.S. Central Time (CT).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Adobe After Effects or other motion graphics tools.
  • Previous experience editing video podcasts or interview-based content.
  • Experience producing content for restaurants, food, hospitality, or local businesses.
  • Previous experience working with a marketing or creative agency.
  • Experience working remotely with U.S.-based clients or teams.
  • Advanced color grading skills beyond basic color correction.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

During the selection process, particular attention will be given to:

  • Overall quality of the candidate's portfolio or reel.
  • Short-form social media editing experience.
  • Ability to create compelling stories from raw footage.
  • Adobe Premiere Pro proficiency.
  • Spanish and English communication skills.
  • Experience with podcasts, interviews, or longer-form storytelling.
  • Understanding of audio, color, captions, and basic motion graphics.
  • Ability to follow creative direction and respond effectively to revisions.
  • Reliability, organization, and ability to meet deadlines consistently.

What Success Looks Like

  • Client videos are delivered consistently and on schedule.
  • Short-form content is engaging, polished, and optimized for each social platform.
  • Longer-form videos communicate clear and compelling stories.
  • Spanish-language podcast episodes maintain strong audio and visual quality.
  • Revision requests are implemented accurately and efficiently.
  • Project files remain organized and easy for the creative team to access.
  • Communication with the U.S.-based team is proactive and dependable.
  • Finished work consistently reflects the client's creative direction and brand.

Why Join Us?

  • 100% remote opportunity from Colombia, Costa Rica, Argentina, or Mexico.
  • Long-term contractor opportunity with a growing U.S. creative agency.
  • Work across social media, branded content, storytelling, events, and podcasts.
  • Edit authentic footage produced by a professional creative team.
  • Work with a variety of businesses and content styles.
  • Have meaningful creative involvement rather than simply executing repetitive edits.
  • Join a small team that values good taste, clear communication, reliability, and storytelling.

Important Notes

  • A portfolio or video reel is required to apply.
  • Applications without a portfolio or reel may not be considered.
  • Candidates should include or be prepared to discuss a project they are particularly proud of.
  • This is a long-term independent contractor opportunity.
  • Candidates must use their own computer, internet connection, and editing software.
  • Candidates must have at least a few hours of overlap with U.S. Central Time during weekdays.
  • Strong Spanish is essential because the role includes editing Spanish-language content.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

raw.title: Underwriter - Energy, Infrastructure, & Project Finance
raw.excerpt: The Energy, Infrastructure, & Project Finance underwriter is responsible for leading all aspects of the underwriting process for complex energy, infrastructure, and project finance loans and investments, including Shared National Credits (SNC).
raw.description:
The Energy, Infrastructure, & Project Finance underwriter is responsible for leading all aspects of the underwriting process for complex energy, infrastructure, and project finance loans and investments, including Shared National Credits (SNC). This role independently assesses credit risk to ensure transactions align with the organization’s credit standards, internal policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines in a fast‑paced environment. This position involves in‑depth analysis of financial models, contracts, due diligence materials, and engineering reports to develop well‑supported credit recommendations for energy and infrastructure projects nationwide.

Are you ready to learn more? Apply and ask about this opening!

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the end‑to‑end underwriting process for energy, infrastructure, and project finance transactions, including loans, tax equity investments, and syndicated facilities.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, internal origination teams, and third‑party providers to obtain all information necessary for a complete and accurate credit assessment.
  • Develop, analyze, and review complex financial models and projections to evaluate project cash flows, sensitivities, and key risks.
  • Underwrite and support the ongoing servicing of Shared National Credit (SNC) loans, working alongside agent banks and participating lenders.
  • Perform independent credit analysis, annual reviews, amendments, waivers, and servicing actions for SNC transactions in accordance with intercreditor agreements and regulatory expectations.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external lender groups to support credit approvals, servicing actions, and portfolio monitoring for SNC exposures.
  • Review agent bank credit packages, financial models, and reporting to assess ongoing performance and emerging risks within SNC portfolios.
  • Perform comprehensive credit analysis by reviewing financial statements, project contracts, legal documentation, and third‑party reports to assess project viability through underwriting and closing.
  • Prepare clear, well‑reasoned credit memoranda for loan committee review, outlining transaction structure, key risks, mitigants, and recommendations.
  • Conduct market, industry, and company research to support underwriting assumptions and credit conclusions.
  • Review and interpret complex legal and structured finance documents related to energy, infrastructure, and project finance transactions.
  • Independently underwrite syndicated loans for both new originations and ongoing servicing actions.
  • Lead credit analysis for early‑stage development opportunities and complex deal structures.
  • Take primary responsibility for portfolio underwriting assignments involving multiple common facilities.
  • Support ongoing portfolio management activities and serve as a subject matter resource for the team.
  • Review the work of other underwriters for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to credit standards.
  • Lead and participate in cross‑functional initiatives focused on process improvement, training, and knowledge sharing.
  • Develop working knowledge of USDA programs and regulations under the OneRD Initiative, with particular emphasis on REAP and B&I eligibility, as applicable to energy and infrastructure projects.
  • Communicate effectively and professionally across multiple channels with internal teams, clients, and third‑party vendors.
  • Maintain a positive, professional demeanor when managing deadlines, changes, and transaction challenges.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to adapt to shifting priorities and evolving business needs.
  • Demonstrated professionalism and discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and related business systems.
  • Advanced analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to apply new information to both current and future decision‑making.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a team‑oriented environment.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong interest in energy, infrastructure, and project finance transactions across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Deep understanding of commercial banking credit policies, loan structuring, and cash flow analysis.
  • Advanced working knowledge of accounting principles, including balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop expert‑level proficiency in specialized financial products.

Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision
    • 401(k) with employer match
    • Life and long-term disability coverage
    • HSA and FSA plans
    • Holidays and paid time off requests
    • Robust wellness program (we’re talking catered meals three times a weeks, lunch and learns, and onsite gym.)

Headquartered in the heart of downtown Salt Lake City, Utah, Celtic Bank was named the fourth largest SBA lender in the nation in 2025! Celtic Bank is a leading nationwide lender specializing in SBA 7(a), SBA 504, USDA B&I, express loans, asset-based loans, commercial real estate loans and commercial construction loans.

Physical and Other Requirements

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. The demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Stationary Work: The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to type, handle documents, and perform other office related duties. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.
  • Mobility: The employee in this position needs to occasionally move between work sites and inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
  • Communicate: The employee is regularly required to talk or hear and will frequently communicate with others. Must be able to read, write and understand fluent English.
  • Work Model: The employee in this position will work either a fully Onsite, Hybrid or Remote work model. All employees, regardless of location, may be required to travel to the Salt Lake City office for mandatory company meetings, events, or related occasions.
    • Utah-based employees: Hybrid work schedule available after initial training period in our Salt Lake City, Utah office – department and job requirements will determine eligibility.
    • Out of State employees: Full remote work schedule available.

kurzbeschreibung

Suchst du eine Herausforderung, die dich erfüllt, in der du täglich nachhaltige Veränderungen bewirken kannst? Als Consultant (m/w/d) bei uns gestaltest du die Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mit – du optimierst Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst Lösungen, die Sinn stiften und eine langfristige Wirkung entfalten.

deine aufgaben

Du wirst eng mit Unternehmen zusammenarbeiten, um deren Abläufe nicht nur effizienter, sondern auch nachhaltiger zu gestalten. Dabei wirst du Geschäftsprozesse analysieren und gemeinsam mit dem Kunden innovative Konzepte entwerfen, die sich in die Praxis umsetzen lassen. Ob bei der Einführung von SAP Waste and Recycling oder unseren SAP IS-U-Lösungen – du wirst die technische Umsetzung begleiten, die Projektphasen mitgestalten und dafür sorgen, dass die neuen Systeme passgenau auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden abgestimmt sind. Mit deiner Arbeit schaffst du echten Mehrwert.

Doch dein Job ist weit mehr als nur Zahlen und Systeme: Du wirst Prozesse und Veränderungen gestalten, die den Arbeitsalltag vieler Menschen verbessern. Deine Lösungen optimieren nicht nur Abläufe, sondern erleichtern das tägliche Handeln der Kunden und fördern nachhaltiges Wirtschaften. Von der ersten Konzeption über das Customizing bis hin zum Testen und der Schulung der Anwender – du begleitest den gesamten Prozess und stellst sicher, dass jeder Schritt sitzt.

Damit der Wandel gelingt, wirst du von Zeit zu Zeit direkt vor Ort tätig sein und in spannenden Projekten im In- und Ausland mitwirken. Dabei ist eine Reisebereitschaft von 30% erforderlich– je nach Projektphase. Du wirst eigenverantwortlich an Projekten arbeiten und lernst dabei, komplexe Aufgaben nicht nur zu bewältigen, sondern kreative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Zukunft mitgestalten.

dein profil

Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Umweltmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen und konntest bereits erste praktische Berufserfahrungen sammeln – idealerweise in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und im Einsatz von Projektmanagement-Methoden.

Mit SAP kennst du dich bereits aus – insbesondere in Modulen wie IS-U, EDM, Gerätemanagement, PM, SD, MM, FI oder CO. Erste Einblicke in ABAP bringst du ebenfalls mit oder bist motiviert, dir dieses Wissen zeitnah anzueignen.

Im Kundenkontakt trittst du sicher und professionell auf – sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch. Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und zielorientiert. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten liegt dir, du organisierst dich gut und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung – auch für kleinere Projekte oder Teilbereiche, die du eigenständig zum Erfolg führst.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und mindestens Englisch Kenntnisse auf B2 Niveau runden dein Profil ab und machen dich zur idealen Verstärkung für unser Team.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt? Dann komm zu uns ins Team und gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft der Circular Economy!

warum wir?

Gemeinsam Zukunft gestalten: sicher, nachhaltig und voller Möglichkeiten!
Was PROLOGIANER ausmacht?
Teamgeist, Gestaltungsspielraum und der Wille, mit Technologie echte Veränderungen zu schaffen. Wir brennen für smarte Lösungen mit echtem Umweltnutzen und jede Menge Begeisterung gehört für uns einfach dazu.

Bei PROLOGA erwartet dich ein Job mit Sinn und Impact: Wir entwickeln Software, die unsere Welt ein Stück sauberer macht. Zero Emissions ist unser Ziel und vielleicht bald auch deins?

Wir sind seit über 20 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt, SAP-Partner – und weiter auf Wachstumskurs. Das heißt für dich: Gestaltungsfreiheit, spannende Perspektiven und jede Menge Raum, um gemeinsam zu wachsen und deine Stärken einzubringen.

Was dich bei uns sonst noch erwartet:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten. Unsere Türen in Halle, Leipzig, Oldenburg und Walldorf stehen jederzeit offen für dich! Wenn du also den direkten Austausch suchst oder einfach die Büroatmosphäre genießen möchtest, bist du herzlich willkommen. Für Teammeetings, Events und Feiern kommen wir gerne zusammen.
  • Choose your Device: Mac oder Windows – du entscheidest, womit du am liebsten arbeitest
  • JobRad-Leasing
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding & individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Volleyballfeld, Sportgruppen & Sommergrillen sowie Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern.

  • Sport- und Teamevents sowie Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern.

....und das ist längst nicht Alles!

raw.title: HIM Coding Editor Specialist I
raw.excerpt: Must have experience with resolving edits and denials for Hospital Billing Services.
raw.companyName: Dallas County Hospital District d/b/a Parkland Health
raw.description:
Must have experience with resolving edits and denials for Hospital Billing Services.


Work Location-Remote

Fully Virtual

Note: Remote positions at Parkland for this team can only hire from candidates who live in these states:

  • Arkansas
  • Wisconsin
  • Texas
  • Florida (cannot hire Miami-Dade county)

Primary Purpose
As a part of our Coding Quality team, our coding editors plan an integral role of reviewing coding quality alerts and/or billing edits for hospital, outpatient and ambulatory encounters. Providing a great review and oversight of opportunities before final billing. This team will also review coding denials and evaluate areas of improvement through out the revenue cycle process.

MINIMUM SPECIFICATIONS

Education

  • Must have successfully completed an approved coding program OR
  • Must be a graduate of a Health Information Management program.


Experience

  • Must have five years of coding experience in an acute care hospital environment.


Equivalent Education and/or Experience

  • May have an equivalent combination of education and experience in lieu of specific education and/or experience as stated above.


Certification/Registration/Licensure

  • Because of the lag in SCCE, HCCA, NCRA, and AHIMA updating the status of certifications, current employees whose certification is granted through one of these associations are allowed up to seven (7) calendar days, after expiration, to provide proof of renewal. Although an additional seven (7) calendar days is allowed to provide proof of renewal, there cannot be a lapse in the certification's 'active' status.
  • Must be certified through the American Health Information Management Association as one of the following:
  • Registered Health Information Management Technician (RHIT)
  • Registered Health Information Management Administrator (RHIA)
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
  • Certified Coding Specialist 'Physician Based (CCS-P)
  • OR
  • Must be certified through the American Association of Procedural Coders as one of the following:
  • Certified Professional Coder-Hospital (CPC-H)
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC)


Skills or Special Abilities

  • Must be able to demonstrate advanced knowledge of coding and abstracting skills.
  • Applicants must pass applicable coding test with an 85% or above prior to placement into position. Current Parkland employees requesting reassignment into role must have applicable coding test on file.
  • Must be able to demonstrate knowledge of reimbursement (Medicare and Medicaid) principles.
  • Must have extensive knowledge of medical terminology, the human disease process, anatomy and physiology.
  • Must be able to demonstrate good organizational and leadership skills.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
  • Must be able to demonstrate knowledge of computer software applications including MS Office.


Responsibilities

  • Verifying accuracy of assigned CPT codes for complex and/or error prone procedures.
  • Verifying diagnosis coding accuracy for complex and/or error prone encounters.
  • Reviewing charge and procedure mismatches
  • Reviewing codes with revenue integrity edits for NCD/LCD coverage
  • Reviewing invalid codes, code conflicts and missing modifiers.
  • Working with other teams in billing, revenue integrity, coding operations, coding compliance and other revenue cycle counter parts.
  • Combining codes for payment window encounters
  • Assisting with resolution of accounts with HIM/Coding unbilled hold reasons preventing final billing.
  • Validating certain discharge dispositions.
  • Assigns appropriate diagnosis and procedure codes, and codes all inpatient and/or outpatient episodes of care recorded in the patient record, including review for APC/MS-DRG options, according to ICD-9-CM /ICD-10 conventions and guidelines, determining secondary diagnoses which meet reporting criteria, and referring to coding references to ensure accuracy of medical records, facilitate record transfer for billing and/or optimize reimbursement for patient care rendered. May assist other coders by training and advising on coding and abstracting according to ICD-9-CM conventions and guidelines, responding to coding inquiries, reviewing and noting coded charts, providing feedback and monitoring chart corrections to ensure that noted changes have been made to facilitate coding consistency, accuracy, efficiency and appropriate billing and reimbursement.
  • Assist in resolving billing edits that are holding patient claims from billing, by reviewing claims information, medical records and other applicable documentation. Assists with work flow, priorities for work completion, and communicating workflow issues to the supervisor. Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction. Makes recommendations to supervisor, implements and monitors results as appropriate in support of the overall goals of the department and Parkland.
  • Serves as a liaison between management, coders, physicians, nurses, medical staff, Patient Financial Services, and hospital employees regarding Correct Coding Initiatives, medical necessity and revenue and coding edit issues. Communicates with physicians and nurses by telephone or in writing to clarify documentation issues by obtaining missing diagnoses, procedures or information, resolving ambiguous coding episodes to ensure that missing information is corrected and resubmitted for payment.
  • Maintains a positive working relationship to ensure that medical record information is documented and coded according to established conventions and Parkland's policies and guidelines.
  • Assist in the identification and reporting of potential quality issues. Maintains knowledge of applicable rules, regulations, policies, laws, and guidelines that impact the coding and abstracting of medical records. Develops root cause analysis that identify systematic issues. Analysis details of benchmarking and creates resolution of the edits. Develops effective internal controls and monitor reports. Promote adherence to applicable state/federal laws, and the program requirements of accreditation agencies and federal, state, and private health plans. Seeks advice and guidance as necessary to ensure proper understanding.
  • Ensure unbilled items are addressed properly and timely. Maintains departmental quality standards, prepares and submits productivity logs to supervisor, as required.
  • Identify and review charging, coding, and clinical documentation issues. Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to help build and scale our outbound motion into the mid-market segment at Steer, multi-location, full service auto repair groups operating 4 or more rooftops. This role is focused on uncovering and developing opportunities with growing repair groups, engaging multiple stakeholders across an organization, and guiding prospects through a longer, more consultative sales process than a typical single-shop deal.

This is not a passive, inbound role. You will be expected to create opportunities from scratch, navigate multi-location organizations with more than one decision-maker, and develop messaging that resonates with owners and operators managing growing, complex businesses. We are looking for someone who is no stranger to overcoming obstacles, comfortable with longer sales cycles, and strives to exceed expectations. Come join a team where skill cultivation, career advancement, and talent retention are core values.

This is a fully remote role for US-based candidates.

Compensation: 65k base + 25-35k variable (90-100k OTE)

You Are

  • A Self-Starter: You are intrinsically motivated, results-oriented, and comfortable operating in a high-volume, outbound-heavy environment.
  • Empathetic & Professional: You are approachable and professional, with a genuine desire to help business owners and operators achieve their goals.
  • Resilient & Persistent: You maintain a positive attitude in the face of rejection, using setbacks as opportunities for growth and learning.
  • A Strong Communicator: You possess a growth mindset and are self-assured in your ability to build rapport across multiple stakeholders and engage in compelling, effective communication.
  • Organized & Disciplined: You are dependable and consistent in meeting deadlines and managing your pipeline activity, including longer, multi-touch sales cycles.
  • Coachable: You are enthusiastic, open to feedback, and committed to continuous improvement.

You Will

  • Drive Outbound Growth: Conduct a high volume of calls and outreach to identify and engage decision-makers and economic buyers at multi-location auto repair groups.
  • Navigate Complex Organizations: Identify and build relationships with multiple stakeholders within a single account, from individual shop leadership to regional or ownership-level decision-makers.
  • Master the Product: Develop a deep understanding of our SaaS product and its features to effectively communicate value during online product demos.
  • Consultative Selling: Employ a consultative approach to understand prospects' needs across a growing organization and tailor presentations to their specific pain points.
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain meticulous records of sales activities and customer interactions in our CRM to ensure accurate forecasting across longer sales cycles.
  • Partner for Success: Qualify opportunities and collaborate closely with the mid-market sales team on strategy and deal progression.

You Have

Must Have:

  • BDR or SDR experience, ideally including outbound prospecting into organizations with more than one decision-maker.
  • Proven Track Record: A history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and activity metrics.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with comfort in phone-based outreach.
  • Presentation Skills: Experience performing product demonstrations and consultations.

Nice to Have:

  • Industry Experience: Familiarity with the automotive industry, home services, or blue-collar sectors.
  • Multi-Location Experience: Experience prospecting into franchise, multi-unit, or multi-location businesses.
  • SaaS Background: Experience selling software or working in a high-growth startup environment.
  • Tech Stack: Experience using CRM tools (like HubSpot or Salesforce) to manage opportunities.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screen (Lead Recruiter) - 30 min
  2. Hiring Manager Interview (Sales Manager) - 30 min
  3. Leadership Interview (CRO) - 30 min
  4. Reference Checks

We also require completion of the Wonderlic Assessment before the end of the process. This is done independently and takes about 20-30 min.

We Offer

  • 100% remote working
  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance
  • Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum
  • FSA & HSA
  • Equity package
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • 401(k)
  • Growth & Learning Stipend
  • WFH Equipment (for your home setup)
  • A collaborative, high-ownership culture with opportunities for career development

Why Join Steer?At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

raw.description:
About AlphaGov

AlphaGov, a division of Casa Moon LLC, helps government agencies and public-sector organizations make informed workforce decisions. Our services include workforce intelligence, labor market analysis, workforce planning, economic development, program evaluation, compensation studies, and infrastructure workforce advisory.

Our model combines internal analytical capacity with a network of more than 2,000 subject matter experts. We translate research into practical decisions, measurable recommendations, and implementation plans.

The opportunity

We are seeking a Technical / Methodology Lead to guide the analytical quality of AlphaGov’s consulting engagements.

You will develop research approaches, oversee analytical work, interpret findings, and help our internal team build repeatable capabilities. You will also identify where specialized expertise is needed and direct the work of external experts.

We do not expect one person to be an expert in every service area. We do expect sound methodological judgment, deep expertise in relevant disciplines, and the ability to recognize when additional expertise is necessary.

Responsibilities

  • Translate client questions and solicitation requirements into defensible research and analytical plans.
  • Define data sources, sampling approaches, comparison groups, assumptions, and analytical methods.
  • Guide internal analysts through data collection, preparation, analysis, and interpretation.
  • Establish standards for source documentation, reproducibility, limitations, and evidence supporting conclusions.
  • Review models, calculations, survey instruments, interview protocols, and analytical outputs.
  • Identify methodological risks, data gaps, and conclusions that exceed the available evidence.
  • Select and coordinate specialized experts for clearly defined technical assignments.
  • Translate findings into practical recommendations for agency leaders.
  • Support client presentations, technical discussions, and stakeholder workshops.
  • Contribute technical approaches, staffing assumptions, and effort estimates to proposals.
  • Build reusable methodologies, analytical templates, and training materials.
  • Work with the independent QA lead to resolve findings before delivery.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more relevant fields: labor economics, workforce analytics, public policy research, compensation analysis, economic development, or program evaluation.
  • Experience designing and delivering applied research or analytical consulting engagements.
  • Strong quantitative skills and the ability to evaluate data quality, assumptions, and methodological limitations.
  • Experience using public datasets and documenting analytical work so another qualified reviewer can reproduce it.
  • Ability to connect analytical findings to operational or policy decisions.
  • Experience supervising analysts or coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Strong technical writing and the ability to explain complex findings to nontechnical audiences.
  • Relevant education or equivalent professional experience supported by completed work.

Preferred qualifications

  • Graduate education in economics, statistics, public policy, public administration, or a related discipline.
  • Experience serving government agencies or other public-sector clients.
  • Familiarity with workforce and economic data sources such as BLS, Census, and state labor market information.
  • Proficiency in relevant analytical tools, such as R, Python, SQL, or advanced Excel.
  • Experience with mixed-method research, survey design, compensation benchmarking, or evaluation design.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical methods and mentoring delivery teams.

Benefits

What success looks like

  • Each engagement uses methods appropriate to the client’s question and available evidence.
  • Findings are traceable, reproducible, and clearly qualified.
  • Recommendations are useful to decision-makers.
  • Specialists contribute where their expertise adds value.
  • Internal analysts become increasingly capable of performing rigorous work independently.
