📌 Mission

Vous accompagnez une organisation dans sa mise en conformité avec les obligations NIS2 (loi du 26 avril 2024). À ce titre, vous soutenez la mise en place d'une politique de sécurité de l'information ainsi que des mesures techniques et organisationnelles associées.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec l'organisation et ses fournisseurs afin de définir, harmoniser et déployer ces politiques de manière concrète et efficace.

Vous intervenez également dans la préparation des audits, inspections et activités de contrôle, afin de permettre à l'organisation de démontrer le respect des obligations NIS2 applicables. Vous assurez le suivi de l'avancement et en rendez compte aux parties prenantes concernées.

📝 Votre profil

Expérience

  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans des environnements IT d'entreprise complexes.
  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité de l'information et en trajectoires de conformité, dans un contexte opérationnel ou organisationnel.
  • Expérience démontrable dans l'implémentation et le déploiement d'un système de management de la sécurité de l'information (SMSI/ISMS), de préférence selon la norme ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Expérience en gestion de projet, notamment dans des approches telles qu'Agile ou Prince2, ainsi qu'en gestion des parties prenantes et en reporting d'avancement.
  • Expérience dans la préparation, l'accompagnement et le suivi d'audits, d'inspections et de procédures de contrôle.
  • Une expérience dans le secteur public ou la sécurité sociale constitue un atout important.

Compétences

  • Connaissance approfondie de la directive NIS2, de sa transposition en droit belge, du référentiel CyberFundamentals (CCB) et des cadres liés à la sécurité de l'information.
  • Bonne compréhension des mesures de sécurité techniques et organisationnelles, ainsi que de leur application pratique au sein des organisations.
  • Capacité à équilibrer les risques de cybersécurité avec les objectifs opérationnels et à communiquer de façon claire et convaincante.
  • Capacité à démontrer la conformité au moyen d'éléments de preuve et d'une documentation adaptée à destination des auditeurs et autorités de contrôle.
  • Approche pragmatique, orientée vers la traduction de principes théoriques en mesures réalisables et efficaces.
  • Autonomie, solide expertise, leadership et force de persuasion.
  • Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles et capacité à collaborer avec des parties prenantes internes et externes variées.

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

What Are We Looking For?

You are an adept sales professional and healthcare thought leader, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the healthcare system, including the department leaders, C-Suite and Board members, with a proven track record of overachieving, leading deals from start to finish. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep industry and product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. Finally, you enjoy building, you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets. If you’re entrepreneur, self-motivated, competitive, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

raw.description:
You desire impactful work.

You’reRGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

The Software Engineering Manager, Investment Technologies leads one or more agile engineering teams responsible for designing, delivering, operating, and continuously improving technology solutions that support RGA’s global Investments organization and investment accounting operations. This role combines people leadership, delivery accountability, engineering depth, and working knowledge of the investment lifecycle to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, resilient, and auditable technology outcomes.


The manager partners with Product Management, investment professionals, operations, accounting, architecture, data, security, risk, and vendor teams to modernize applications, workflows, APIs, integrations, and data capabilities spanning the front, middle, and back office. The role establishes a high-performing engineering culture, develops talent, manages capacity and financial commitments, and ensures teams deliver in alignment with RGA’s technology strategy, Product Delivery Operating Model, engineering standards, and regulatory obligations.


Principal Duties


  • Engineering Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop software engineers across the full employee lifecycle; set clear expectations, strengthen technical capability, promote inclusion and accountability, and build succession and workforce plans aligned to the product roadmap.
  • Delivery Accountability: Own predictable delivery and operational outcomes for the team’s products and services, balancing business features, regulatory commitments, platform modernization, technical debt, reliability, and production support.
  • Investment Business Partnership: Develop trusted relationships with Investments, Investment Operations, and Investment Accounting leaders; understand business processes and control points across portfolio management, trading, settlement, positions, valuations, performance, risk, cash, securities accounting, reconciliation, and financial reporting.
  • Product and Agile Execution: Partner with Product Management and Product Owners to shape roadmaps, refine outcomes, manage dependencies, plan capacity, and translate investment-business needs into well-defined engineering work within an agile, product-oriented operating model.
  • Architecture and Technical Direction: Partner with solution, enterprise, data, cloud, and security architects to implement target-state architecture and approved patterns across applications, APIs, integration, data, and infrastructure. Ensure teams make sound design decisions without shifting architectural accountability away from designated architecture roles.
  • Software Engineering Excellence: Establish and uphold standards for secure coding, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, documentation, release management, and maintainability. Remain technically close enough to delivery to evaluate designs, coach engineers, remove impediments, and make informed trade-offs.
  • Cloud, Data, and Integration Delivery: Guide delivery of modern web applications, services, data pipelines, and integrations using cloud-native, serverless or containerized patterns; API-first services; event-driven, streaming, batch, and file-based integration; and modern analytical data platforms.
  • Vendor Ecosystem Management: Oversee engineering around investment platforms and external providers—including order and portfolio management, investment accounting, private markets, market data, custodians, and analytics solutions—and contribute to build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions, vendor performance, upgrades, and integration strategies.
  • Reliability and Operations: Ensure production services meet expectations for availability, recoverability, performance, monitoring, incident response, problem management, and disaster recovery. Use operational metrics and root-cause analysis to improve service health and reduce recurring issues.
  • Risk, Security, and Controls: Embed security, privacy, segregation of duties, data lineage, traceability, logging, evidence retention, and other control requirements into delivery. Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Finance to support SOX ITGC, SOC 1/2, model governance, and related obligations.
  • Financial and Resource Management: Manage team budget, vendor spend, staffing mix, hiring, capacity, and forecasts; make transparent trade-offs and ensure resources are aligned to the highest-value business outcomes.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging technologies—including generative AI and agentic engineering tools—and introduce them responsibly to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and investment workflows while adhering to security, data, legal, and model-risk requirements.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate delivery progress, operational health, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and decisions clearly to audiences ranging from engineers and business specialists to senior executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Required.
  • Master’s degree in a relevant technology, engineering, business, finance, or quantitative discipline. Preferred.

Work Experience


  • 9+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, application development, platform engineering, data engineering, or related technology disciplines. Required.
  • 3+ years of formal people-management experience leading software engineering teams, including performance management, coaching, hiring, workforce planning, and talent development. Required.
  • Demonstrated accountability for delivering and operating business-critical technology products or platforms in a complex enterprise environment. Required.
  • Experience supporting investments, asset management, investment accounting, capital markets, treasury, finance, or other financially oriented business capabilities. Required.
  • Experience in insurance or reinsurance, an insurer general account, asset management, banking, pension, or an investment-platform provider. Preferred.
  • Experience operating in an agile, product-oriented technology organization and partnering with Product Management, architecture, security, data governance, risk, and business stakeholders. Required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities


  • Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including object-oriented and functional design, modular services, APIs, event-driven architecture, automated testing, secure software development, source control, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure as code.
  • Working fluency across modern application, data, and cloud technologies. Relevant experience may include Python, Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, React-class front ends, SQL, REST or GraphQL APIs, Terraform, containers, serverless computing, workflow orchestration, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Hands-on understanding of AWS or a comparable public-cloud ecosystem, including compute, containers, serverless services, eventing, identity and access management, networking, monitoring, resilience, and cost management.
  • Practical knowledge of investment data and processes, including trade lifecycle, positions and transactions, security master and reference data, pricing and valuations, cash, corporate actions, performance and risk, reconciliation, and interfaces between investment operations and investment accounting.
  • Understanding of front-, middle-, and back-office operating models and of investment-book and accounting-book concepts such as IBOR and ABOR; familiarity with performance or planning books and multi-basis accounting is beneficial.
  • Knowledge of one or more asset classes such as fixed income, public equity, derivatives, structured assets, private credit, real estate, or other private markets investments.
  • Ability to lead engineering teams integrating with major investment platforms, accounting systems, market-data providers, custodians, and internal data platforms. Experience with platforms such as Aladdin, Bloomberg, SimCorp, Eagle, Clearwater, PAM-class systems, or comparable products is beneficial but not required for every candidate.
  • Understanding of financial and insurance control environments, including auditability, data lineage, access controls, change management, segregation of duties, model governance, SOX ITGC, and SOC reporting.
  • Strong judgment in balancing delivery speed, business value, architectural alignment, risk, quality, operational resilience, and total cost of ownership.
  • Advanced leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate between investment, accounting, risk, and engineering audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and dependencies, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and create clarity for teams operating through transformation.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, inclusive leadership, constructive feedback, and a culture in which engineers are empowered to own outcomes.

Preferred Experience

  • Insurance or reinsurance general-account investments, including statutory, GAAP, or other multi-basis investment accounting and reporting.
  • Asset-liability management and the interface among Investments, Finance, Risk, Treasury, and Actuarial functions.
  • Private credit, private markets, structured assets, or alternative-investment platforms and workflows.
  • Large-scale modernization of legacy investment applications, integrations, and data platforms.
  • Responsible adoption of generative AI, agentic tooling, or AI-assisted software engineering and business workflows.
  • Managing a blended workforce of employees, consultants, strategic partners, and software vendors across locations or time zones.

What you can expect from RGA:

  • Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

  • Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

  • Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

We’re excited to get to know you and connect your unique skills with our global opportunities. To create a modern and seamless experience, we use artificial intelligence (AI) in parts of our preliminary screening process. This technology helps us personalize job recommendations, automate interview scheduling, evaluate candidates based solely on experience—without considering name, gender, or other personal details—and provide real-time answers through our chatbot. AI is used only during early screening and never makes hiring decisions. Your RGA recruiter will work closely with you every step of the way to ensure the process feels personal, thoughtful, and focused on you.

Compensation Range:

$107,060.00 - $159,390.00 Annual

Base pay varies depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and market location. In addition, RGA provides an annual bonus plan that includes all roles and some positions are eligible for participation in our long-term equity incentive plan. RGA also maintains a full range of health, retirement, and other employee benefits.

RGA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, gender identity or expression, sex, disability, veteran status, religion, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

Who We Are

Icon Health is a leading provider of value-based musculoskeletal (MSK) care, collaborating with payers and providers to enhance outcomes and experience for individuals. The company partners with health plans and risk-bearing providers to assume accountability for reduced total cost of care. By combining technology-enabled MSK providers with proactive care coordination and decision support services, Icon Health delivers multidisciplinary, evidence-based care.

We founded Icon Health on the conviction that every patient should be genuinely delighted with their care experience. By prioritizing patient-centered practices, ensuring clear care goals across the entire clinical team, and placing clinicians at the heart of care delivery, we aim to transform a fragmented system into one that truly serves patients. Our model uses a team-based approach to care, integrating musculoskeletal expertise and primary care to achieve better patient outcomes.

At Icon Health, we foster a culture that embraces bold thinking, rapid iteration, and practical problem-solving. We seek team members who relish challenging the status quo and thrive in vertically integrated roles—where ideas can swiftly move from concept to execution without layers of red tape. The Innovation Lab Lead drives rapid, high-impact ideation and proof-of-concept sessions with Adobe's prospective enterprise customers under the Horizon pre-sales program. Operating at the nexus of strategy, technology, and customer activation, this role designs and facilitates week-long innovation labs that translate business challenges into validated AI and agentic capability demonstrations.

The Lab Lead combines strong facilitation skills with deep Adobe solution knowledge to unlock new sales pipeline opportunities and co-author the technical business cases that move deals forward.

Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities below reflect core accountability for this role across customer engagements and team operations.

  • Design and facilitate customer innovation labs. This includes leading early-stage discovery workshops that distill customer pain points into scoped, prototype-able scenarios aligned to Horizon's evaluation and committed build phases.
  • Candidates should have the ability to surface high-value use cases and validate product-market fit for emerging Adobe AI and agentic capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with Adobe Technical Presales and the Lead Architect to map customer business objectives to Adobe Ecosystem Solutions (such as GenStudio, Firefly, and CX Enterprise CoWorker) and to custom AI-driven capabilities that we ideate, design, develop, and deploy.
  • Manage pre-commitment evaluation planning, ensuring customer insights translate into clear scope, success criteria, and resource plans for downstream delivery.

  • Develop and refine repeatable lab methodologies, playbooks, and evaluation frameworks that scale across multiple customer contexts with the Adobe Horizon (AI Pilot) program team.
  • Maintain clear, executive-level communications with customers and Adobe stakeholders on innovation progress, learning, and next steps.

  • Previous experience and proven ability to demonstrate workshop design and facilitation experience, with ability to guide senior technical and business stakeholders through discovery and ideation.
  • Extensive experience engaging executive stakeholders with strong executive presence, including building and designing executive-level workshops, solutions, and reporting/KPIs across marketing, technology, business, brand, and finance functions.
  • Deep working knowledge of at least three Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, to help bridge ideation of AI solutions into core Adobe SKUs and capabilities.
  • Prior experience in pre-sales, customer innovation, or solution engineering roles with ability to rapidly scope complex, ambiguous challenges.
  • Strong business acumen with ability to translate customer objectives into quantifiable value cases and technology recommendations.
  • Proven experience initiating and implementing AI initiatives within organizations.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration; ability to synthesize learning across multiple engagements and adapt approaches based on customer feedback.
  • Track record of managing multi-stakeholder, time-bound engagements with competing priorities and tight delivery windows.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred: experience within Financial Services, Healthcare, or Pharmaceutical organizations, which represent the largest share of the current portfolio.
  • Experience with change management and operational efficiency is a plus.
  • Track record of delivering trackable ROI on initiatives led.

  • Innovation labs consistently surface high-conviction use cases and convert prospective customers into pre-commitment evaluation or build engagements.
  • Lab findings are synthesized into clear business cases and technical roadmaps that inform customer investment decisions.
  • Customers experience structured, high-impact thinking that positions Merkle and Adobe as trusted, forward-looking partners.
  • Lab playbooks and evaluation frameworks are refined and scaled across additional customer contexts.

raw.description:
Job Description:

B12's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it. Our engineers are responsible for prioritizing, conceptualizing, co-designing, building, testing, and engaging users for any concept we are building out. We’re generalists in encouraging each other to experience the full stack, but we’re also aware of each other’s preferences in the stack. For this role in particular, we’re searching for a tenured full-stack engineer who brings strong backend/infrastructure skills (and an interest in using them) to the product. We mentor and teach where we can, both inside and outside of the company, and as a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible not only for your ownership of major projects, but also mentorship of the team members with whom you ship those projects.

We value sharing our work with the outside world. Our team has published papers on forming expert flash teams and machine-mediated worker hierarchies. We’ve baked our research into various open source tools in the space of creativity, expertise, and knowledge work.

We hope our engineers have more longevity than any one tool we use, but here is a sampling of our current thoughts about technology:

  • We live on Python/Django and TypeScript/React.
  • We store blobs in Amazon’s S3, munch on them in Amazon’s EC2, develop in Docker, and deploy containers to Amazon’s Elastic Beanstalk.
  • We believe PostgreSQL should be the first system you consider when thinking about persisting structured data.
  • We clean and centralize data in Amazon’s Redshift, and are able to answer almost any question in SQL.
  • We leverage AI in our product and our internal tooling, and faced with a landscape in constant flux, try to pick the right model or agent on a task-by-task basis.
  • Our new code is almost 100% LLM-generated, and we’ve thought hard about ensuring quality in the face of ever-increasing review loads, what processes humans are still best at, and how the practice of mentorship must adapt in the face of these new tools.
  • We have near-full test coverage on the backend, and are making progress on our frontend and integration tests.
  • We set up continuous integration and deployment because, while this model comes with its own pains, we’ve disliked being on fixed release schedules on previous projects.
  • We like to move fast and support point-in-time recovery :).

You’d be a good fit if

  • You have 10 or more years of experience building products and systems in production.
  • You are an amazing communicator.
  • You feel comfortable managing your time and deciding among competing priorities.
  • You are curious.
  • You have a high ownership mentality.
  • You enjoy learning and teaching.
  • You are comfortable working with backend and frontend technologies, but have a deeper background and interest on the backend/infrastructure side.
  • You care about and want to contribute to our mission of helping people do meaningful work.

What does a staff engineer do here?

This is B12’s first Staff Engineer hire on a ~10-person product team that includes a designer, product manager, and CTO. To understand what we’re looking for in someone with this much experience, here are some concrete examples of tasks you’d work on in a month:

  • Own the delivery of a project of the magnitude “we ship one or two of these a quarter,” both individually shipping code and rallying and supporting team members in doing so.
  • Participate in quarterly planning to identify key projects to work on next quarter.
  • Mentor other engineers who are in the planning, prototyping, or implementation phases of a project.
  • Respond to an incident, write up a postmortem, and improve tooling and infrastructure to help us prevent or more quickly respond to the issue and others like it in the future.
  • Identify and optimize some infrastructure that costs too much, is too slow, or isn’t stable enough.
  • Discuss an early design/prototype with a designer or product manager to help shape its direction and explain what will be easy or hard to implement.
  • Unblock an operational team member on a data analysis project that answers a hairy question facing our business.
  • Run a brainstorm with engineers to identify how we might work more effectively or ship with a higher level of quality.

Don’t fear:

  • We highly favor talent and interest.
  • Some candidates may see this list and feel discouraged because they don’t match all the items. Please apply anyway: there’s a good chance you’re more wonderful than you think you are.
  • B12 is a safe place for human beings. We particularly encourage you to apply if you identify as a woman, are a person of color or other underrepresented minority, or are a member of the LGBTQIA community.

raw.description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a hands-on software engineer with years of experience building complex web applications, who has led teams through delivery and is comfortable making decisions across disparate technologies. You have deep skill in either backend or frontend engineering and are genuinely conversant in the other, enough to review the work, spot the risk, and make the call when the two sides disagree.

Required

Core Tasks

1. Architecture and technical direction

  • Assess the current system — codebase, data model, infrastructure, dependencies — and produce a written architecture assessment with prioritized risks.
  • Define the target architecture for [project scope], including service boundaries, data flow, integration points, and the migration path from where the system is today.
  • Make and document the technology decisions the project depends on, with tradeoffs stated. Where the decision is reversible, say so; where it is not, make the case explicitly.
  • Set the engineering standards the team works to: code review expectations, testing strategy, branching and release process, definition of done.

2.Hands-on delivery

  • Write production code on the critical path — [expected split, e.g., roughly 50–60% of your time is hands-on].
  • Take the hardest or highest-risk pieces yourself: the parts where a wrong call early is expensive to unwind.
  • Review the team's work and hold the quality bar without becoming the bottleneck.
  • Own the deployment pipeline and release process for the duration of the engagement.

3.Team leadership

  • Lead a team of engineers (contract and/or in-house), including [e.g., the project-based backend engineer, frontend contractors, QA].
  • Break the scope into work that can be assigned, sequenced, and tracked; keep the team unblocked.
  • Run the working rhythm: standups, planning, retrospectives, or whatever cadence fits a team this size.
  • Mentor as you go — the team should be more capable of maintaining this system at the end of the engagement than at the start.

4. Project management and stakeholder communication

  • Own the delivery plan: estimates, sequencing, dependencies, and the critical path.
  • Report status to leadership on a weekly cadence — what shipped, what slipped, what is at risk, and what decision you need from them.
  • Raise scope, timeline, and resourcing risks early and in writing, with options rather than just problems.
  • Translate between technical constraints and business tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders.

Deliverables

  • Architecture assessment and target-state design document, reviewed and approved by project lead.
  • Delivery plan with milestones, estimates, dependencies, and named owners.
  • Architecture decision records for the significant technology choices made during the engagement.
  • Working, production-deployed software within the agreed scope, built by you and the team you lead.
  • Documented engineering standards: testing strategy, review process, release process.
  • Weekly written status reports across the engagement.
  • Handoff package: system documentation, operational runbook, known limitations, recommended next phase of work, and a walkthrough with the team that will maintain it.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of development and project management experience
  • Project management — you have owned a delivery timeline, not just a backlog, and have brought a project in against a date.
  • Team management — experience leading engineers day to day: assigning work, reviewing it, unblocking people, and having the direct conversation when something is off track.
  • Python — production experience building and maintaining backend services.
  • TypeScript — production experience on the frontend and/or in Node services.
  • SQL — fluent in writing, reading, and optimizing queries; comfortable reasoning about schema design and query performance.
  • API development — you have designed APIs that other teams or customers consumed, and you know what makes them painful to consume.

Nice To Haves

  • Domain experience in medical software and/or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and privacy constraints that come with HIPAA / PCI / other environments.
  • Cloud infrastructure experience on AWS / GCP / Azure, including CI/CD and managed databases.
  • Prior contract or consulting work where you owned a scope end to end and delivered it without close supervision.

How we will work together

  • You report to the project lead and are the single technical point of accountability for this engagement.
  • Written status update at the close of each week; sync with leadership.
  • You have decision authority over technology choices, sequencing, code standards, decisions on etc
  • Tooling: [repo host, project tracker, chat, cloud account access].

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Work well in a team environment to ensure partner and customer satisfaction
Design a compelling value proposition that inspires this strategic partner to promote our solutions.

Develop/activate services based on our emerging and established technologies increasing revenue growth, and liaise closely with our product teams to innovate new solutions and GTM strategies to drive new ways to differentiate in the market and take market share (drive scale).

Provide clear and consistent communication (internally and externally) across the region with partners to build strong partnerships throughout your assignment.

Lead regular business performance and relationship reviews with senior management and various stakeholders.

Build and maintain the activity of performance reports and activity dashboards.

Qualifications

Your Experience

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

You will build smart code that thinks proactively for our users, suggesting adverts and products to them. And we know, we are not first on it but boy what an impact it will have. A win win win for fun, needed code, the environment, and Blocket moving into the future – in a new red dress!

Who you are

You are able to independently lead the development of new features, and enjoy discussing and debating code and solutions with your peers. You like sharing your knowledge with your cross functional team and also more junior developers and above all, you are curious and continuously strive to learn new things. We are often working in pairs so collaboration is another key. And the thinking and problem solving mindset. The goal is what we create as a team, not the techniques we use. raw.description:
Advanced Utility Systems, a division of Harris; is seeking a Senior Account Executive who is a proven new-business hunter ready to join our sales team.

You will win new municipal utility customers for our CIS Infinity platform and the products around it. This role is not an account management or install base expansion position. We hire people who open doors, earn a seat at the table before the RFP exists, and carry a pursuit from first conversation to signed contract.

Municipal utility buying decisions run through formal procurement. Boards, city councils, finance directors, and operations leaders all weigh in, and the RFP often decides the outcome. The Account Executive who wins in this market builds relationships early, understands what a utility is trying to fix, and helps shape the evaluation criteria before a competitor does. You will treat every RFP as a campaign that starts months before the document is published, not as a form to complete after it arrives.

This is an individual contributor role, built to be rewarding and fulfilling as a career in its own right. It carries no formal management duties. It does offer an informal opportunity to mentor and develop a new sales team member who supports new customer acquisition, and to guide that person as an aide to your pursuit work. We plan to expand the sales team to grow faster in 2027 and 2028, and you will help shape how new sellers learn our market and our process. You will also set the pace for how our sales organization uses AI in RFP response, proposal writing, demonstrations, and closing. Leadership development is a possible path for people who succeed in the role and want it, but it is not a requirement of the job.

The Profile We Recruit:

A seasoned enterprise software hunter who has sold to municipal utilities and won. You earn business by building trust with public sector buyers over long cycles, and you can show the deals you opened, not the accounts you inherited. You see AI as a practical tool for winning more bids with less effort.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST timezone.

Salary:

85K - 95K

OTE including base: Up to 200K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

Win New Municipal Utility Accounts

  • Own a new-logo quota across North American municipal electric, water, wastewater, and gas utilities, with no install base farming responsibility.
  • Build and work a target account plan that identifies utilities with aging CIS platforms, upcoming contract expirations, leadership changes, and budget cycles that signal a buying window.
  • Develop relationships with the full buying group, including utility managers, finance directors, customer service leaders, IT leaders, and city or board decision makers.
  • Run disciplined discovery that connects a utility's operational pain, such as staff retirements, billing accuracy, call volume, and cost to serve, to a business case the buying committee can defend.
  • Apply MEDDPICC to qualify opportunities, manage the funnel, and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast. Report on pursuit health, win rates, and lessons from lost deals.

Shape RFPs Before They Are Written

  • Engage prospects early, during needs assessment, budget planning, and consultant selection, so that our platform capabilities inform the requirements a utility writes.
  • Build working relationships with utility consultants, procurement officers, and the consulting firms that often draft RFPs.
  • Make a disciplined bid or no-bid recommendation for every RFP, weighing fit, relationship strength, competitive position, and cost of pursuit.
  • Own the RFP response from kickoff to submission, and coordinate product, professional services, and finance contributors to meet deadlines with a compliant, persuasive proposal.
  • Lead orals, finalist demonstrations, reference calls, and best-and-final negotiations through contract signature.

Mentor and Develop New Sales Talent

  • Mentor a new sales team member, including a sales engineer or sales intern, in an informal guidance role. You do not manage this person's performance, pay, or employment.
  • Bring that person into your pursuits as an aide, and give them real exposure to account research, RFP support, discovery calls, and demonstrations.
  • Show how you build relationships, qualify opportunities, and shape an RFP, so the person learns our approach to new customer acquisition by working on live deals.
  • Help prepare demonstrations that follow each utility's stated requirements and workflows, working alongside the sales engineering function.
  • Share what you learn with sales leadership, so the team can bring new sellers on faster as we grow in 2027 and 2028.

Accelerate AI Adoption in the Sales Process

  • Use AI tools to analyze RFPs, extract requirements, draft compliant responses, and build tailored proposals in a fraction of the current cycle time.
  • Apply AI to account research, stakeholder mapping, demo preparation, and closing plans so that the team enters each meeting better prepared.
  • Work with sales leadership and R&D to document which AI-assisted practices improve win rates and response quality, and share them across the sales organization.
  • Measure results with concrete metrics, including hours saved per RFP, proposal quality, bid volume handled, and win rate.

What we are looking for:

  • Five or more years of quota-carrying software sales experience, with a recent track record selling CIS, billing, or other enterprise software to municipal utilities or comparable public sector buyers.
  • A history of new-logo success. You can name the utilities you won, the size of each deal, the length of the cycle, and your role in it. Candidates whose results came mainly from renewals, upsells, or install base expansion will not fit this role.
  • Demonstrated experience with public sector procurement, including RFP response, bid or no-bid decisions, evaluation scoring, orals, and contract negotiation.
  • Proven ability to influence a buying process before the RFP is issued, through consultant relationships, requirement shaping, and executive sponsorship.
  • Strong relationship builder with credibility among utility managers, finance leaders, and board or council members.
  • Clear, persuasive writer who can produce or direct an executive summary, a differentiated technical response, and a pricing narrative.
  • Willingness to mentor a new sales team member informally, and the ability to work effectively with a sales engineer or demo specialist. Prior management experience is not required.
  • Commitment to learn and apply MEDDPICC. Advanced has adopted this framework to guide funnel management and sales process discipline, and it supports scalable growth. You will use it to qualify opportunities, build pursuit plans, and forecast. Prior experience helps, but a willingness to learn it and use it consistently is required.
  • Curiosity and hands-on initiative with AI tools. You can describe how you have used them, or how you would use them, to shorten proposal cycles and raise quality.
  • Willingness to travel to prospect sites, conferences, and finalist presentations, as the pursuit calendar requires.

What would make you stand out:

  • Knowledge of the meter-to-cash cycle and the challenges facing municipal utilities, including workforce retirements, aging systems, and pressure to reduce cost to serve.
  • An existing network among North American municipal utilities, utility associations, and utility consulting firms.
  • Experience selling against established CIS competitors and displacing a legacy platform.
  • Prior working knowledge of MEDDPICC or a similar qualification framework, such as MEDDIC or Challenger.
  • Familiarity with CRM and pursuit management tools, and with proposal automation platforms.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!
  • A Market Position Worth Building On: Advanced serves the North American municipal utility industry with 30 years of domain experience. You sell the leading private cloud for utilities platform with a modernization roadmap and a credible AI story, into a market where aging systems and workforce retirements push utilities to act.

raw.description:
Job Description

ABOUT VICTAULIC

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world's most critical and prestigious structures.


An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation

At Victaulic, we're committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

Let's Build a Better World Together.

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

• We build from within.

• We stand behind our people.

  • We foster an environment for constant learning.
  • We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE

Victaulic's Enterprise Data & AI Services organization is scaling a formal AI Governance capability spanning policy, risk classification, vendor and model risk assessment, and platform-enabled compliance monitoring. As Senior AI Risk Analyst, you will execute and continuously improve Victaulic's AI risk assessment processes by evaluating AI use cases, vendor and model risk, and agentic and generative AI deployments against Victaulic's AI Governance Framework (V-RAIF) and Acceptable Use Policy (AUP v2.0). You will work hands-on in Victaulic's AI governance platform, Credo AI, and partner closely with Legal, Cybersecurity, Procurement, and business stakeholders to help AI adoption move quickly without introducing unmanaged risk.


WHAT YOU'LL BUILD & OWN

  • Execute end-to-end AI use case risk assessments using Victaulic's formal 41-item risk assessment checklist across six phases, producing clear risk ratings and mitigation recommendations.
  • Administer and continuously improve AI risk workflows in Credo AI, including intake forms, risk-scoring logic, evidence collection, and reporting dashboards.
  • Apply Victaulic's three-tier risk classification model to new AI agents, generative AI tools, and MCP or connector integrations as they move through the registration process.
  • Lead AI vendor and contract risk reviews, including data rights, intellectual property ownership, audit rights, and model change notification, in partnership with Legal and Procurement.
  • Build and maintain repeatable governance processes and playbooks for intake, triage, escalation, remediation tracking, and periodic reassessment so risk review scales with AI adoption across the business.
  • Prepare risk findings, metrics, and talking points for the AI Governance Committee and executive updates.
  • Monitor the regulatory and standards landscape, including NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act, and translate relevant changes into updates to Victaulic's Acceptable Use Policy and governance artifacts.
  • Partner with AI Engineering, Data Governance, and AI Enablement & Adoption to ensure risk controls are embedded in delivery rather than added after the fact.
  • Support insurance and cyber-risk assessments related to AI use and contribute to incident and near-miss reviews involving AI systems.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of experience in AI or technology risk, compliance, information security, or IT governance, including at least 2 years focused specifically on AI or machine learning risk.
  • Direct, hands-on experience configuring workflows, risk assessments, or governance reporting in Credo AI.
  • A demonstrated track record of building AI governance processes from the ground up, such as intake and triage workflows, risk classification models, or assessment checklists.
  • Working knowledge of AI risk and governance frameworks, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or an equivalent framework, and how they translate into operational controls.
  • Experience evaluating third-party AI or SaaS vendor contracts for data rights, intellectual property, and audit-rights risk.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for governance committees or senior stakeholders.
  • Structured, checklist-driven risk thinking balanced with pragmatic judgment about business impact.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity while a governance program is being built.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work fluently with Legal, Cybersecurity, Procurement, and business and technical teams.
  • A platform-oriented mindset that treats Credo AI as a system to configure and improve, not simply a form to complete.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Risk Management, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Familiarity with agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration risk.
  • Certification such as CIPP/AI, AIGP, CISA, or CRISC.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or industrial enterprise IT environment.

WHAT WE OFFER


Build A Better Career

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.
  • Career development programs and internal promotion pathways - we build from within.
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities.

Build A Better Future

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Retirement savings plans with company match.
  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

Build A Better You

  • Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable.
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources.
  • Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another.

Build A Better World

  • Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day.

IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP

Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full-time basis without the need for employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.


EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. Background checks may be required as part of our pre-employment process.


VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY

All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries, and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic's Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process.


Let's Build a Better World Together.

Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Customer & Technical Support Specialist at Nextiva, you’ll be on the front lines of delivering exceptional customer experiences. You’re not just solving issues, you’re uncovering the “why,” guiding customers to the right solutions, and making their day easier.

As a Technical Support Representative, you will deliver Amazing Service® through high-quality technical support services by processing and resolving requests received across various communication channels; while continuously growing your skills in a fast-paced, learning environment. You’ll leverage modern tools, including AI, to work smarter, move faster, and deliver even better outcomes for customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Solve What Matters: Troubleshoot customer issues across hardware, software, and networking systems, quickly identifying root causes and driving resolution
  • Deliver Great Experiences: Communicate clearly and professionally to ensure every interaction is positive and productive
  • Stay on the Details: Document customer interactions, issues, and resolutions with accuracy and consistency
  • Keep Systems Running: Provide, maintain, and update systems to ensure optimal performance for customers; managing multiple requests simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
  • Own the Outcome: Take full ownership of customer issues, following through until resolution while meeting daily and monthly performance metrics
  • Continuous Learning: Continuously build technical knowledge of Nextiva products, systems, and troubleshooting processes to provide better service. Explore new tools and ways of working to improve performance
  • Work Smarter:
    • Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to support daily workflows, such as summarizing customer interactions, identifying key action items, and improving response quality
    • Apply clear and structured inputs when using AI tools to generate accurate and relevant outputs; iterating and refining your approach when the responses aren't perfect (persistence is key!)

About You:

  • 2+ years of customer service experience, preferably in technical support or help desk environment
  • Working knowledge of PC and Mac operating systems and Microsoft Office applications; hardware and/or networking knowledge preferred
  • Advanced English fluency required (spoken and written).
  • Ability to work remotely in Ukraine and regularly work shifts aligned with US business hours (between 12:00pm-4:00am Monday through Friday)
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with evolving tools and processes

Core Competencies:

  • Customer First: Patient, conscientious and professional; providing great customer experiences with a focus on accuracy
  • Problem Solver: Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with a persistent, solution-oriented mindset; able to overcome setbacks and willing to try multiple paths to reach the right solution
  • Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple tasks or conversations simultaneously; strong attention to detail in both technical work and documentation
  • AI-Forward Mindset: Curiosity and willingness to experiment with AI & automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot); exposure to similar tools in a professional environment preferred
  • Team-Driven: You collaborate, share knowledge, and contribute to a positive team environment

Why Nextiva?

  • Impact: Join a company trusted by over a million users, helping businesses deliver better customer experiences every day
  • Innovation: Be part of a team building AI-powered solutions that drive efficiency and smarter customer engagement
  • Growth: Thrive in a culture focused on continuous learning, development, and career progression
  • Culture: Work alongside a supportive, high-energy team committed to Amazing Service® and meaningful connections

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

  • Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
  • Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.
  • Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can do their best.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, incentives, or bonuses.

  • Health 🍏 – Comprehensive medical coverage, individual limit on exclusions and dental care
  • Insurance 💼– Life, disability, traumatic injuries and critical diseases
  • Work-Life Balance ⚖️ – PTO for all employees, Paid Sick leave (official document required), paid parental leave and paid holidays
  • Wellness 🤸‍ – Employee Assistance Program and wellness initiatives
  • Growth 🌱 – Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI-powered, conversation-centric platform.

Want to see what life at Nextiva is all about? Connect with us on Instagram, Instagram MX, YouTube, LinkedIn, and the Nextiva Blog.

raw.title: Founding Product Marketing Lead
raw.excerpt: About SpangleAI Launched in 2025, Spangle AI helps enterprise retailers win AI-driven product discovery, connecting discovery to conversion.
raw.description:
About SpangleAI

Launched in 2025, Spangle AI helps enterprise retailers win AI-driven product discovery, connecting discovery to conversion. We've partnered with enterprise brands like REVOLVE, Alexander Wang, and Steve Madden, delivering up to 50% conversion lifts and 2x ROAS improvements.

Spangle creates commerce experiences around customer intent. Generic AI knows the internet. Spangle knows your brand.

Backed by top tier VCs with $21M in funding, Spangle is founded by serial entrepreneurs with 30+ years scaling AI and commerce at Amazon, Saks, and Gap, we're building the commerce infrastructure for the agentic era, where ChatGPT Shopping, Google AI Overviews, and Meta are reshaping how consumers discover and buy.

Spangle won NRF’s VIP (Vendor in Partnership) Award for Best AI-Driven Marketing Solution and was recognized in Business of Fashion’s AI startups to Watch within its first year of launch.

The Role

Own Spangle's product marketing end-to-end. Translate our positioning into every artifact that turns strategy into revenue: website, demos, customer stories, sales enablement, founder platform, and buyer education. Make Spangle the company every enterprise retailer thinks of when they need to win AI-driven product discovery.

Your primary job is to make complex ideas obvious. If we're successful, the market will understand Spangle before they ever talk to Sales.

This is not a traditional VP Marketing role or a demand-gen role. It's a founding product marketer who ships. You'll roll up your sleeves and create the artifacts that turn product and customer insights into a repeatable commercial advantage. You'll work directly with founders, customers, product, and sales, and use AI extensively as a force multiplier.

If you want to define a new category with real customers, real proof, and a founder who's built at scale before, this is it. You'll help define how one of the first AI-native enterprise software companies is built.

What you'll personally own

  • The website. Rewrite it. Continuously improve it. Every buyer who arrives should immediately understand Spangle's differentiation. Own the words, the demo flow, and the customer proof surfaces.
  • Customer discovery. Spend time with customers every week. Learn how buyers describe their problems, what objections keep coming up, and what language lands. Feed those insights back into Product, Sales, and company messaging. Customer discovery feeds every other artifact you'll produce. The best product marketer at this stage is part product manager, part storyteller.
  • Sales narrative and demo, with Product and Sales. One story every salesperson tells. Demo flow that shows how the engine reasons across customer intent, brand, catalog, and business context. That reasoning is the "aha" that separates Spangle from AI-visibility measurement and personalization in 90 seconds. Sales deck. ROI framing. Objection-handling talk tracks.
  • Customer stories. Turn every enterprise customer into a reusable narrative. Written case studies, video, on-stage moments, quotes for the press.
  • Founder platform and thought leadership. Company LinkedIn cadence and content quality. Keynote materials, panel prep, podcast prep. Op-ed placement in BoF, Modern Retail, Digital Commerce 360. Editorial calendar around the Observation ("Customers experience one brand. Retailers still operate through disconnected teams, tools, and workflows"). Long-form essays on our mission.
  • Buyer education content. Canonical glossary and educational pages that help buyers understand what Spangle does before they meet us. Flagship comparison pages. FAQ, how-to, and decision-help content that compounds for years. Buyers first; AI discoverability follows.
  • Analyst and influencer relationships. Forrester, Gartner, IDC coverage of commerce + AI. Retail-tech influencers who shape category conversation. Direct relationships, not agency-mediated. These come after content and story exist; not before.
  • Press and conference presence. Modern Retail, BoF, Digital Commerce 360, Glossy, Retail Dive, business and tech media. Stage strategy across Shoptalk, NRF, BoF VOICES, eTail. We have meaningful connections into Shoptalk and NRF programming that we'll introduce you to.

How you'll work

Lean by design. Personally build the foundation. Scale the team only when the business genuinely requires it.

  • Month 0–6: just you, plus AI tools, plus one design/video contractor as needed.
  • Month 6–12: possibly add a content marketer or marketing analytics specialist if measured signal justifies.
  • Year 2: consider one specialist hire only if the business requires it.

We expect you to use AI as a force multiplier in your daily work. We care about output, not headcount. No outside PR firms. No agency layers. Direct relationships, AI-amplified outreach, you own it.

Who succeeds here

  • Writes exceptionally well. Homepage, essay, deck, press release, LinkedIn post. You can ship any of them and they'll be good.
  • Uses AI daily to accelerate the work. Claude, GPT, Perplexity, Cursor in your workflow. You have built personal automations and can walk us through your stack with specificity.
  • Ships quickly. More things done than said.
  • Comfortable creating with little structure. You don't need briefs; you generate them.
  • Equally comfortable talking to customers, writing a homepage, building a demo narrative, or briefing an analyst. You don't specialize in one channel; you own the whole story.
  • Wants to build the market, not manage a marketing department.

What We're Looking For

Required experience

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing; last 3–5 as senior IC or founding PMM at a Series A–C startup that compounded into a recognized name.
  • Track record of personally writing and shipping category-defining artifacts. Homepage, launch narratives, sales decks, customer stories, comparison pages, analyst briefings. With your hands on the work, not your name on the org chart.
  • Positioning-first thinker. You lead with messaging architecture, competitive positioning, and buyer-language rigor. Sales enablement is a natural downstream output for you, not a separate skill.
  • Comfort with measurement. You treat positioning as testable hypotheses and have built dashboards.
  • Founder-partner energy. Amplify a founder voice; don't replace it.

Ideal experience

  • Founding PMM at a company that went $0 → $20M+ ARR with a small team.
  • AI-native startup background (Anthropic, OpenAI, Perplexity, Cursor, Linear, Vercel, Cohere, Notion) or commerce-adjacent (Klaviyo, Attentive, Shopify Plus partners).
  • Compounded a positioning across surfaces at scale.
  • Experience creating evergreen educational content that compounds over time.
  • Direct working relationships with B2B SaaS press and analysts, or a retail-tech press network.

Our Culture

  • GenAI-native in how we build, sell, and operate
  • High ownership, low overhead, and bias toward action
  • Focus on speed, experimentation, and execution
  • Deep emphasis on creating clear, demonstrable customer value
  • Preference for builders and operators over hierarchy
  • Strong belief in in-person collaboration

Why Spangle

  • Opportunity to shape enterprise sales for a category-defining GenAI commerce platform
  • Direct partnership with the founding team who built AI solutions at scale for Amazon, Saks and marquee brands and retailers
  • Meaningful ownership and impact at an early stage with ample career growth opportunities
  • Competitive salary with uncapped commission and equity
  • Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), Unlimited PTO

Spangle is an equal opportunity employer.

To apply please share your resume and cover letter including:

  1. A short note on why this role and why now
  2. Three pieces of content you personally shipped in the last 12 months — links to the content, plus a one-sentence note on what each produced
  3. A description of your AI stack and one automation you built that compounded

Reporting to the Head of Finance, the Experienced Book Keeper will be responsible for the entire Accounts Receivable function, ensuring invoices are sent out efficiently and cash is collected in a timely manner. You will act as an important business partner across the company, working with the B2B team to ensure that invoices are sent with correct details and in a timely manner.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities Include:

Accounts Receivable

  • Reconcile UK, US and UAE bank accounts daily via Xero Software
  • Raise, review, approve and issue all invoices on behalf of the B2B team, liaising with them to ensure correct wording and the right contact
  • Send weekly statements of account to key customers
  • Prepare and distribute a weekly AR report to the B2B team
  • Identify balances requiring chasing and independently manage the chasing process, escalating issues to the Head of Finance or CFO as needed
  • Chase remittances for unallocated funds received
  • Perform customer reconciliations and maintain accurate customer data, resolving any historic discrepancies

  • Respond to customer and internal queries within 7 hours
  • Handle ad hoc queries in a timely manner (e.g. adding PO numbers to invoices once issued)
  • Business partner with the B2B team to help re-engage unresponsive customers
  • Manage new customer set-up, ensuring the new customer form is completed before invoices are issued

Accounts Payable

  • Own the entire Accounts Payable function, including:
    • Bank and supplier-statement reconciliations
    • Purchase invoice processing
    • Month-end reconciliation
    • Managing the Outlook inbox and responding to queries within 24 hours
  • High-volume, business-as-usual work across three international companies
  • Reconcile monthly supplier statement
  • Intercompany Recs

Additional Responsibilities

  • Must be willing to work in a small team and be prepared to be flexible and assist the team with other work as required
  • Assist with invoice coding of daily invoice received from key flower supplier
  • Attach credit card receipts from the team into the accounting system

The Ideal Candidate:

Essential

  • Strong Xero reconciliation experience
  • Experience managing the entire AR & AP function independently
  • A strong communicator and who is always ready to help the team
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Outlook
  • Able to work independently

Desirable

  • Experience with ApprovalMax, Dext, and/or Bill.com; PLEO experience is a bonus but not required
  • Accounting qualification, or actively working towards one
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools ( to speed up bookkeeping tasks, reduce manual data entry.

What We're Looking For

  • A genuine interest in building a career in finance, with the drive to fully commit to a rapidly-scaling business
  • Commercially minded, with an interest in the product/category space
  • Collaborative and personable, with strong communication skills when working with non-financial colleagues
  • Flexible and responsive, comfortable liaising with teams across the UK / US / UAE and reacting quickly to issues
  • Willing to attend the London North Acton warehouse for occasional team days

Benefits

  • A chance to grow and develop yourself alongside an exciting progression path with a fast paced, growing business
  • A monthly flower subscription and discounted products
  • 25 days' annual leave + bank holidays
  • Optional Life Insurance
  • Optional Health and Dental Insurance
  • Monthly coworking budget
  • Day-off for your birthday
  • Time off to support your favourite charity

Senior Director, Account Management East PA

What you will be doing:

The Senior Director (AM) serves as the enterprise account owner for assigned member organizations, responsible for developing and executing integrated strategies that drive growth, retention, and value realization across the Premier portfolio of solutions and services.

This role builds and maintains strategic relationships across the member organization—including C-suite executives and key stakeholders—to understand business priorities and position Premier as a critical partner in delivering operational, clinical, and financial performance improvement.

The AM acts as the member’s central point of contact and “quarterback,” coordinating cross-functional Premier teams (Sales, GPO/Supply Chain, Technology, Advisory, Customer Success, AI/Analytics, and others) to deliver an integrated, high-value experience.

The AM is accountable for achieving defined growth, retention, and member value outcomes, aligning Premier capabilities to member needs and ensuring measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

Member Relationships & Account Strategy (40%)

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across the member organization, including executive leadership (CEO, CFO, COO, and other C-suite stakeholders)

  • Establish presence “up the chain” with senior decision-makers to influence strategy and partnership direction

  • Serve as the single point of accountability and central liaison for the member relationship

  • Develop, maintain, and execute integrated strategic account plans aligned to the member’s priorities, financial drivers, and long-term objectives

  • Lead regular executive engagement cadence, including executive business reviews and executive-level discussions on performance and opportunities

  • Coordinate and align cross-functional Premier resources to ensure consistent, enterprise-wide engagement

  • Maintain deep understanding of member strategy, including stated priorities and emerging or unmet needs

Growth (25%)

Retention & Value Realization (20%)
