What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We are hiring a design lead: a player-coach for someone who still loves to design while also having a passion to make other designers better.

This role sit within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

As a player-coach, you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick. You'll grow and coach the team, raise the craft, and build the practices that let design scale with the company.

This role is remote, with occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.
  • Evolve our design competencies into a standard the whole company can understand and then make it operate. Today that bar largely lives in people's heads. Making it explicit, defensible, and consistently applied.
  • Support career growth by running development conversations, writing performance reviews with business-unit leaders, and making the path from one level to the next clear
  • Take on real design work yourself. Everything from hard problems, quick wins, exploratory concepts, and the things that unblock the team.
  • Partner with leadership to align design direction with product strategy and company goals.
  • Build and strengthen design systems that enable consistency, quality, and scalability. This includes raising the team's leverage with AI by helping to drive forward efforts to make our design system agentic-friendly so prototypes can be built from real components.
  • Shape design practices across discovery, concept development, interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.
  • Encourage exploration and push the team to rethink assumptions while staying grounded in user needs and market realities.
  • Advocate for the customer experience across every surface and ensure design decisions always reflect real customer needs.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product design experience with 2+ years of management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support senior designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user centered craft.
  • Experience building and scaling design systems.
  • AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.
  • Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces and turn loose ideas into compelling product concepts.
  • Strong cross functional communication skills and experience working closely with cross-functional leadership
  • Experience with a variety of user research methods. You know how to get answers from users yourself and help your designers do the same.
  • Excitement about shaping the future of the industry by designing experiences that support meaningful work.
  • Experience leading design across multiple products or surfaces. Two-sided marketplace experience is a strong plus.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Job Description:

Transform technology into opportunity as a Performance Tester / Platform Engineer at GDIT. Shape what’s next for mission-critical government projects while shaping what’s next for your engineering career.


The Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office (AO) of the US Courts (AO) develop a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States which are grouped into three types, namely Appellate, District, and Bankruptcy. This modernized case management system will eventually replace the current Case Management and Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) system.


The Performance Tester / Platform Engineer will work as part of an agile development team to build and support the modernization of enterprise-class software applications.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As a Performance Tester / Platform Engineer, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of US Courts. You will play a crucial role in the following areas:

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated performance testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications
  • Define and track key performance KPIs (e.g., response time, throughput, resource utilization, latency, error rates) based on SLAs and stakeholder requirements
  • Conduct load, stress, and scalability testing to validate performance under multi-tenant conditions and concurrent user loads
  • Develop and manage a performance dashboard and provide executive-level and technical-level reporting on system behavior
  • Perform real-time monitoring, observability, and telemetry setup for application and infrastructure performance using modern tools and dashboards
  • Collaborate with developers, QA, SREs, and operations teams to identify performance bottlenecks and provide optimization recommendations
  • Validate the performance of critical workflows and use cases, including long-running queries, search operations, and API endpoints
  • Capture and report on system metrics such as CPU, memory, disk, network, and application-specific logs for tuning and diagnostics
  • Contribute to the performance section of the Monthly Status Report (MSR) and sprint-level performance documentation
  • Ensure alignment of performance testing strategy with DevSecOps and MLOps processes for continuous integration and delivery
  • Developing and executing formal performance test plans to ensure the delivery of quality software applications
  • Composing and maintaining comprehensive test plans and reports
  • Verifying and validating functionality by evaluating software against system requirements
  • Responsible for supporting cloud solution resources, both IaaS and PaaS, that enable the business to securely run sensitive workloads within a cloud
  • Implementing and designing server, network, and software configurations for a cloud computing infrastructure and applications with a focus on DevOps principles

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your engineering expertise along with a drive for innovation to GDIT. The Performance Tester / Platform Engineer must have:

● Education: Bachelor of Science

● Experience: 5+ years of related experience; 1+ year should involve deploying and managing applications and systems to commercial and private clouds

● Required Skills:

  • Experience in performance engineering and automated testing of cloud-based applications and platforms
  • Strong knowledge of performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, LoadRunner, BlazeMeter, or k6
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch, or Elastic Stack
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or JavaScript for automation of testing and reporting workflows
  • Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices testing strategies
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure performance characteristics, especially AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Experience with telemetry frameworks and logging standards to support traceability and root cause analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large volumes of test data, identify trends, and drive root cause identification and tuning
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and participating in sprint ceremonies
  • Experienced in providing DevSecOps implementation using GitOps, or similar tools
  • Experienced in developing, testing, and maintaining containerized applications utilizing docker, k8s, Openshift, etc.
  • Working knowledge of Source Version Control and Build/Release tools and methodologies
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Test planning, writing test cases/scripts, test case automation, performance test execution and analysis of performance test results
  • Familiarity with standard concepts, practices, and procedures of cloud technology, including Software as Service (SaaS), Platform as Service (PaaS), or Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
  • Supporting large scale infrastructure migration methodologies and techniques (IaaS/PaaS) including application migrations to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)

● Security Clearance Level: Ability to obtain a position of Public Trust with the Administrative Office of the US Courts

● Must be a US Person (Green Card Holder, US Permanent Resident Alien, Refugee, Asylee, US Citizen)

● Location: Remote

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
● Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home
● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your ambition to deliver your best work.

About AlphaGov

AlphaGov, a division of Casa Moon LLC, helps government agencies and public-sector organizations make informed workforce decisions. Our work includes workforce intelligence, labor market analysis, workforce planning, economic development, program evaluation, compensation studies, and infrastructure workforce advisory.

We combine an internal delivery team with a network of more than 2,000 subject matter experts. We are building a consulting practice that delivers practical, measurable recommendations and supports clients through implementation.

The opportunity

We are seeking a Delivery Lead / Senior Project Manager to manage consulting engagements from award and kickoff through final acceptance.

You will own project execution: scope, schedules, budgets, staffing, client communication, and delivery coordination. You will work closely with our technical lead, internal analysts, independent reviewers, and external specialists.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can build effective delivery processes while managing active client work.

Responsibilities

  • Translate proposals and contracts into clear work plans, deliverables, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project budgets, resource allocations, dependencies, risks, and changes in scope.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact and lead progress meetings.
  • Assign work to internal staff and engage external experts for defined technical needs.
  • Coordinate technical and quality reviews before deliverables reach clients.
  • Monitor actual hours, forecast remaining effort, and identify potential budget or schedule problems early.
  • Document decisions, client approvals, scope changes, and delivery obligations.
  • Coordinate invoicing milestones and supporting documentation with finance.
  • Help develop realistic delivery plans and cost estimates for proposals.
  • Build reusable project templates, workflows, and lessons learned.
  • Develop internal staff so AlphaGov can perform more qualified delivery work in-house.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience leading consulting, research, or advisory engagements with multiple contributors.
  • Experience managing public-sector clients or engagements with formal contractual deliverables and acceptance requirements.
  • Ability to manage project finances, schedules, scope changes, and competing priorities.
  • Experience coordinating technical specialists, analysts, and subcontractors.
  • Strong client communication, business writing, and meeting facilitation skills.
  • Ability to turn complex requirements into clear assignments and accountable work plans.
  • Willingness to work directly on delivery details while building a growing practice.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in workforce planning, compensation studies, economic development, program evaluation, or infrastructure advisory.
  • Experience managing government contracts and supporting proposal development.
  • PMP or a comparable project management credential.
  • Experience building delivery processes for a consulting organization.

Benefits

What success looks like

  • Projects have clear ownership, realistic budgets, and documented acceptance criteria.
  • Clients receive timely communication and reliable deliverables.
  • Scope changes and delivery risks are addressed early.
  • Internal staff and external experts work as one accountable team.
  • Each engagement strengthens AlphaGov’s delivery capability and government past performance.

raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Partner Development Manager, MSSP Ecosystem, you will be tasked with owning account management, partner enablement, and partnership support for a defined, named set of MSP/MSSP Ecosystem partners that sell through MSSPs, as part of SentinelOne's Global MSSP Ecosystem team. Unlike the regionally-aligned Partner Development Manager role, your book of business is fixed by name rather than territory, and you'll report into the Director, Global MSSP Ecosystem Sales. You'll design high-quality, strategic service activation plans for each named partner, growing wallet share and reducing churn within an existing, high-value book rather than recruiting net-new logos.

This role requires moderate travel (typically 25 to 50 percent) to build and sustain in-person relationships with your named partners.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own and grow a fixed, named portfolio of 3 to 10 MSSP Ecosystem partners, serving as the primary business owner of each relationship and building revenue-generating security service offerings with each.
  • Develop and execute a strategic business plan for each named partner to manage innovation, collaboration, and the next logical areas for business expansion within the partnership.
  • Establish and maintain senior relationships within your named partners, nurturing partner executives and key sales leaders to align priorities across respective field organizations and build a "better together" flywheel that holds up against competitive threats.
  • Drive new pipeline and revenue through each partner's marketplace or distribution motion, using data to sharpen strategy and tactics and establish competitive advantage for SentinelOne's established and emerging product portfolio; stay current on the SentinelOne competitive landscape and sell the value of our solutions and services relative to competitors.
  • Ensure partners receive timely product and MSP/MSSP model updates for each relevant product area, work with internal teams to build service offerings and develop launch content, and drive program management and governance for service offering launches across your named accounts.
  • Develop and drive KPI metrics to assess partnership effectiveness, regularly reviewing partner engagement and performance and adjusting strategy as needed, with a demonstrable track record of setting and hitting financial goals with focus partners.
  • Ensure each named partner is equipped with the tools and resources to scale their go-to-market and compete effectively, and establish enablement goals that validate partners meet the training, certification, and support requirements of the partner program.
  • Evangelize partner service offerings and bring the voice of the partner back into SentinelOne's sales organization.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate revenue forecasts for your named book of business, staying aligned with the Director, Global MSSP Ecosystem Sales, and peer Partner Development Managers on forecasting, enablement, and the launch of newly created solutions with your partners.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and Support to reduce churn, close deals, and drive revenue and product adoption, including designing and implementing joint go-to-market campaigns and running a disciplined account planning cadence aligned to MEDDPICC.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • A BS technical degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 5 or more years of above-quota sales experience, preferably as a Regional Sales Executive/Manager selling full-stack security solutions across endpoint, identity, data, and cloud, with a background in high-tech sales and a record of outperforming the market.
  • A strong partner background across managed offering providers, including MSP, MSSP, MDR, XDR, outsourcers, distribution, and systems integrators, with prior experience selling to Service Providers and/or Managed Security Service Providers.
  • Experience managing a concentrated, named book of strategic accounts rather than a broad territory, including expanding product footprint and executing strategic business plans; comfort with fewer, deeper relationships, ideally with a track record of driving double- or triple-digit revenue growth at the partner level and exposure to platform-commit or similarly concentrated partner relationships.
  • Deep knowledge of current security solutions, including indirect and managed sales motions (fully managed, co-managed, single- and two-tier); CSP marketplace experience is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage a variety of technical and business leaders internally and externally, including at the executive level.
  • Enterprise sales experience with an actionable network of MSSP decision makers.
  • Superb organizational and reporting skills, strong leadership skills, and the motivation of a focused self-starter who does whatever it takes to deliver above-quota performance, working both independently and collaboratively within a team, with a passion for security.
  • Experience growing the sales enablement function to support sales in a rapidly evolving, competitive marketplace.
  • Prior startup experience, plus experience working with channel partners and a strong understanding of partner-centric go-to-market approaches.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

raw.title: Strategic Project Manager
raw.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
raw.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

  • Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

  • Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

raw.description:
About OfficeSpace:

OfficeSpace Software provides the leading AI operating system for the built world, that helps teams plan, connect, and perform in the workplace. As a performance-based, PE-backed company, we hire based on merit and a willingness to do what it takes to succeed long-term. You’re a great fit for the role if you’re entrepreneurial, passionate, motivated by building at light speed, and an Agentic AI early adopter. Our world-class teams operate in the US, Canada, and Costa Rica in a culture of trust, respect, growth, and impact.

About the role:

As a Solutions Consultant, you’ll shape how prospective customers understand, evaluate, and adopt OfficeSpace. You’ll partner with Account Executives to lead discovery, architect solutions, deliver compelling demonstrations, and guide complex technical evaluations across Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, IT, HR, and Workplace teams. You’ll turn business challenges and technical complexity into clear decisions and measurable outcomes. AI will accelerate how you research, prepare, design, and execute—but your judgment, storytelling, technical credibility, and ability to earn customer trust will make the difference.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the technical and solution strategy across complex sales opportunities—from discovery through validation and close.
  • Lead high-impact discovery that uncovers business problems, workflows, technical requirements, success criteria, decision drivers, and hidden risks.
  • Translate customer needs into solution architectures that connect OfficeSpace capabilities to measurable workplace and business outcomes.
  • Design and deliver tailored demonstrations that tell the customer’s story, adapt in real time, and make complex capabilities easy to understand.
  • Lead technical evaluations and POCs with clear hypotheses, use cases, success criteria, dependencies, and decision paths.
  • Navigate enterprise architecture conversations across APIs, webhooks, SSO, identity management, employee data, Microsoft 365, security, and related systems. Identify technical risks early.
  • Partner with Product, Professional Services, Customer Success, Security, and other experts to build a credible path forward.
  • Orchestrate AI tools and agents to accelerate account research, discovery preparation, demo planning, technical research, solution design, and first-draft customer deliverables.
  • Verify AI-generated outputs before they influence customer recommendations, technical decisions, or external communications.
  • Help customers separate practical AI opportunities from hype and connect emerging capabilities to real workplace outcomes.
  • Lead complex RFPs, RFIs, security reviews, solution diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation assumptions—with AI handling repeatable synthesis and drafting where appropriate.
  • Build reusable discovery frameworks, technical patterns, prompts, demo assets, and AI-enabled workflows that raise the performance of the broader Solutions Consulting team.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solution Engineering, or technical consulting in SaaS.
  • Experience owning technical and solution strategy within complex B2B SaaS sales cycles.
  • Strong discovery skills. You move beyond stated requirements to uncover the real business problem, technical constraints, decision criteria, and outcomes that matter.
  • A track record of designing and delivering compelling software demonstrations for business, technical, and executive audiences.
  • Strong technical aptitude across enterprise software, integrations, APIs, identity, data flows, security, and solution architecture.
  • The ability to turn technical complexity into clear, relevant, outcome-driven recommendations.
  • Hands-on fluency with generative AI, agentic AI, and LLM-based tools in professional workflows—including an understanding of their limitations and verification requirements.
  • Strong AI orchestration skills. You can define an objective, provide the right context, structure an AI workflow, evaluate its output, verify critical claims, and decide where human judgment must take over.
  • The judgment to distinguish high-value AI applications from automation that creates unnecessary risk or complexity.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and storytelling skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple opportunities without losing rigor, context, or customer trust.
  • A consultative mindset and the credibility to work across end users, technical teams, business leaders, and executives.
  • Experience with IWMS, workplace technology, enterprise integrations, POCs, RFPs, or technical evaluations is valuable.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL APIs, webhooks, SSO/SAML, SCIM, Microsoft 365, SaaS security and privacy concepts, AI agents, or prompt design is a plus.

Why OfficeSpace?

  • High-Performance Culture: At OfficeSpace, we believe in the power of accountability, focus, and drive. Our A-Player team members work together to deliver measurable, meaningful results. We recognize and reward those who push boundaries and achieve excellence.
  • Ownership and Accountability: We trust our employees to take full ownership of their roles, providing the autonomy to innovate and the support to succeed. We seek individuals who are self-motivated and thrive in an environment where they can drive impactful outcomes.
  • Technology-Forward: As a company invested in cutting-edge technology, we integrate AI and other advanced solutions across our platform to enhance productivity, customer experience, and process efficiency. Our team members are excited by the potential of AI and proactively explore ways it can drive our success.
  • Growth Mindset: Continuous learning and improvement are integral to our culture. We encourage our team to embrace challenges, seek knowledge, and develop both personally and professionally.
  • Innovation and Agility: We foster a dynamic, fast-paced environment where fresh ideas and bold solutions are celebrated. We embrace change and thrive on turning challenges into opportunities, with a team that is agile, proactive, and resilient.
  • Collaborative, Results-Driven Environment: We value purposeful collaboration that leads to shared success and stronger results. While our team members are independent, they recognize the value of working together to drive our mission forward.
  • Competitive Benefits and Rewards: OfficeSpace offers comprehensive and competitive benefits packages globally, designed to support our team’s health, well-being, and financial security. We invest in our people so they can excel.

    OfficeSpace is committed to building and promoting a diverse workforce and celebrates the unique qualities that individuals of various backgrounds and experiences offer. We are committed to basing all employment-related decisions upon valid job-related factors without regard to race, color, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, religion, national origin, genetic information, military status, veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by law.

When a family reaches out with a question, a party booking, or a concern, someone on the Customer Relations & Event Support team is on the other end. That someone could be you.

About the Role

As a Customer Relations & Event Support Specialist, you are often the first voice or message a family encounters when they reach out to Lava Island. You answer questions, help with party planning, resolve concerns, and keep our online presence responsive and warm. You work closely with each park's onsite team to make sure guests get what they need, and you do it all from home, on a schedule built around covering our East Coast parks from the start of their day.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Work fully remote from Georgia or Connecticut with a schedule that respects your time
  • Be part of a team that makes families feel heard and taken care of
  • Real opportunity for advancement as we open new parks every year
  • Structured schedule flexibility, we build the week around coverage
  • Competitive pay, benefits, and recognition for great work

What You’ll Do

You are the voice of Lava Island for guests reaching out from outside the park. You handle inbound communication across every channel with warmth, clarity, and care.

Answer guests and keep them moving

  • Manage and respond to incoming text messages professionally and efficiently.
  • Answer party-related questions for guests who have already booked their events.
  • Coordinate callback times with potential party hosts, and schedule the follow-ups that turn interest into bookings.
  • Assist guests with rescheduling parties and finalize details on bookings made in person.

Handle concerns with care

  • Support guests through escalations, staying calm with upset customers and communicating with park managers to resolve issues.
  • Loop in the right people at the right park, so no issue sits waiting.

Support the parks behind the scenes

  • Coordinate with each park’s onsite team for location-specific inquiries.
  • Pull and generate daily reports to help onsite teams stay on top of their day.
  • Take on other tasks assigned by the Customer Relations & Event Support Team Lead as the team’s work evolves.

Who We’re Looking For

The Specialists who do well on this team are:

  • Warm and guest-focused. You want the family on the other end to feel heard.
  • A clear, confident communicator in writing and on the phone.
  • Steady under pressure. You stay calm when a guest is not, and you handle it with grace.
  • Dependable and adaptable. Fast-paced days do not throw you off.
  • You look for ways to make the guest experience better, not just respond to what lands in your queue.
  • A team player. You back up the parks, back up your teammates, and share what is working.
  • Comfortable with technology, learning new tools quickly and using them well.

Bonus Skills: Hospitality, event management, social media engagement, Spanish

What You’ll Need

  • Availability starting at 6:30 AM ET, including Friday, Saturday, and Sunday
  • Residence in Georgia or Connecticut
  • Reliable internet connection at your remote workspace
  • A quiet, professional workspace at home
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high-pressure situations
  • Must be 18 years or older and pass a background check

Ready to be the voice families remember? Apply today.

Salary: $22-$25 per hour

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation.For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive (AE) to drive net new revenue and expand existing business within large-scale auto repair chains, MSOs (multi-shop operators), and franchise systems. This role is ideal for someone who excels in complex sales cycles, understands the automotive aftermarket or vertical SaaS space, and thrives in a consultative sales environment.

As an Enterprise AE, you’ll own the full sales cycle from strategic prospecting through contract negotiation. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to craft compelling solutions tailored to enterprise client needs.

What You’ll Do

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive full-cycle sales processes for enterprise-level deals ($100K+ ACV), from lead to close
  • Prospect and build relationships with decision-makers at the C-suite, VP, and Director levels
  • Conduct discovery and consultative conversations to understand the business needs, pain points, and workflows of complex automotive service organizations
  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and Product Marketing to deliver customized demos and proposals
  • Manage pipeline and forecast with precision using [CRM tool, e.g., Salesforce]
  • Negotiate and close complex contracts with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles (3–9 months)
  • Work closely with Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure a seamless onboarding experience
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and client meetings to represent [Company Name] and stay up to date with market trends
  • Contribute feedback to product and marketing teams based on customer insights and market shifts

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience in Enterprise SaaS, ideally within vertical software or auto aftermarket/repair space
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding $1M+ annual quota in enterprise sales
  • Experience selling to C-level stakeholders and managing complex, multi-threaded sales processes
  • Strong business acumen and consultative selling skills
  • Proficiency in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce), sales enablement platforms, and sales forecasting
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills

Preferred:

  • Knowledge of the automotive repair industry or shop management platforms
  • Experience selling into MSOs, franchise systems, or field operations-heavy organizations
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
  • Equity/stock options
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Generous PTO, parental leave, and wellness benefits
  • High-impact role with significant growth opportunities

Ready to Drive the Future of Shop Management?

If you're a seasoned enterprise seller who’s passionate about solving real operational challenges for large-scale clients — and you want to be part of a team that's reshaping the automotive service industry — we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

About the role

As Ema scales, our corporate IT environment tools, access, devices, and compliance has outgrown an ownership-by-default model. We're hiring an IT Engineer to own it end to end.

This is not a traditional helpdesk role. Ema is an agentic AI company, and we expect our own internal operations to reflect that. You'll run corporate IT while systematically automating it, using agentic tooling to remove the manual work rather than absorbing it. The measure of success in this role is how little of it remains manual after a year and every employee’s experience is great.

What you'll do

  • Agentic Workflows & Automation: Treat every recurring manual task as an automation candidate, extending existing systems and leveraging AI coding tools to design autonomous workflows.

  • Automated Identity & Access: Shift JML lifecycles, including global employee onboarding, Okta/SCIM provisioning, and access reviews from ticket-driven processes to policy-driven automation.

  • SaaS Lifecycle Automation: Programmatically maintain tool inventories, track utilization, and reclaim unused licenses automatically.

  • Automated Endpoint Security: Manage fleet MDM while automating OS patching, encryption baselines, and continuous drift detection.

  • Automated Compliance & Security: Generate audit evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and AI governance frameworks as a continuous byproduct of automated operations.

  • Operational Excellence: Standardize IT runbooks, manage integration registries, and deliver Tier 1/2 support with defined SLAs.

  • Advise other functions: Act as the in-house expert for Finance and HR when tool or subscription administration hits a snag - from access and licensing to renewals and billing questions.

What we're looking for

  • Automation Instinct & Agentic Tools: Strong drive to eliminate repetitive work using AI coding tools, Python/Bash scripting, and API integrations.

  • IT & Security Operations: 0–2 years of experience managing Cloud/SaaS infrastructure, Okta/IdP, Google Workspace, and MDM platforms.

  • Security & Process Discipline: Strict adherence to security protocols, precise documentation habits, and sound judgment when handling compliance risks.

  • Communication & Documentation: Exceptional clarity in technical writing and verbal communication, as you will be the primary interface for internal stakeholders and will need to maintain clear, concise documentation for all automated processes.

Why Ema?

  • Pioneer agentic AI. Build at the absolute frontier of technology to drive tangible enterprise-wide evolution.

  • End-to-end platform ownership. Opportunity to contribute and scale the mission-critical infrastructure that defines our core capabilities.

  • High-density engineering talent. Collaborate with a lean team of researchers and product builders focused on deep, rigorous execution.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

Build What Matters at RevStar

  • Role Title: Data & AI Engineer (Databricks Specialist)
  • Reports To: Data & AI Practice Lead
  • Location: Remote (US-Based / Eastern or Central Time Zone Preferred)
  • Employment Type: Full-Time W2

Ready to build greenfield Lakehouse solutions at the bleeding edge of AI and big data? RevStar is an innovation shop and official Databricks Partner launching a dedicated, cloud-agnostic Data, ML, and AI practice. Tired of spending months in endless corporate approval loops only to build AI concepts that never reach production? We turn modern Lakehouse architectures and production AI into live, scalable enterprise solutions in fast-paced execution cycles. We build fast, cut bureaucratic red tape, and ship production-ready solutions for client founders and tech leaders who value real engineering impact. In this role, you will work directly with data architects, scientists, and client leaders to turn complex data into scalable, production-ready AI models. Above all, our team operates on three core principles:

  • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.
  • Shared Destiny: We rise or fall together.

Your Impact Pillars

1. Databricks Lakehouse & Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark and Delta Lake across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). Implement robust Lakehouse architectures that seamlessly process both structured and unstructured data at enterprise scale. Automate data ingestion, storage, and feature engineering workflows to support downstream analytics and real-time AI workloads.

2. Performance Tuning & MLOps Integration: Fine-tune Spark jobs for low latency, high throughput, and maximum cloud cost-efficiency across client environments. Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to operationalize AI models inside Databricks using MLflow for tracking, versioning, and deployment. Implement robust CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Databricks CLI) to establish automated, production-grade deployments.

3. Data Governance & Client Leadership: Enforce enterprise data security, access controls, and compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2) within Unity Catalog and cloud ecosystems. Collaborate directly with client tech leaders, product managers, and engineering teams to translate complex AI data requirements into clear business outcomes. Author clean technical documentation and lead seamless solution handoffs to client engineering teams upon project completion.

Requirements

What You Bring

    • Core Experience: 3+ years in cloud-native data engineering with 2+ years of dedicated, hands-on Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow experience.
    • Technical Mastery: High proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark frameworks, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or Databricks CLI).
    • Strong Differentiator: Active Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Associate or Professional) or Databricks ML Professional certification is strongly preferred and will set your application apart.
    • Consulting Mindset: Proven track record operating in fast-paced Agile/DevOps consulting environments, delivering cloud-agnostic architectures with exceptional client communication.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive.
  • Remote-First Working Environment – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage – Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Plan for your future with access to a company-sponsored 401(k) program.
  • Annual Learning & Development Stipend – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses.
  • Peer Mentorship & Coaching – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities – Exposure to cutting-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
  • Company Outings & Volunteer Opportunities – Build relationships and give back to the community.
  • Collaborative, Innovative Culture – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

raw.description:
CST Project Manager (eCOA Manager) ** Remote SERBIA **

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Job Summary;


Provides customer-focused management of Clinical Surveillance & Training (CST) scoped services to support scientific integrity and data quality in clinical trials.

Duties also include liaising with customers, vendors and/or investigative sites to manage projects start-up to final deliverables to the customer. Upon displaying proficiency, a CST Project Manager II may be awarded the opportunity to function at the CST Sr. Project Manager level.

Core Responsibilities;


• Working under the limited guidance and mentorship of the CST Director BU Ops, Management (Line Manager) or designee:

  • Function as a representative of the Clinical Surveillance & Training (CST) team on small to large-sized studies or programs, interact with other functional groups, vendors, license holders, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and Sponsors. May serve as a Project Lead in CST stand-alone projects and serves as a Functional Lead in full scope or multiple protocol projects.
  • Manage CST deliverables pertaining to scoped services vendors (i.e., Rater Training vendors), scale license holders and/or KOLs.
    • Manage all aspects of license procurement, scale translation requirements, and paper scale worksheet development.
    • Manage creation of all CST service-related documentation and templates. This may include managing development and testing of the CST Study Training and Engagement Portal (STEP) to meet study-specific Rater Training needs.
    • Manage all aspects of CST services to ensure quality and timely delivery and implementation.
  • Develop and maintain the study-specific CST plan in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs).
  • Contribute to relevant functional project plans to ensure alignment with the CST plan.
  • Provide regular and timely status updates to internal and Sponsor project teams regarding CST scoped services, including risks to delivery such as timeline delays and serve as a central point of contact for CST-related project issues and solicit support from LM or CST SMEs, as required.
  • Create and maintain CST metric reports for scoped services, for delivery to client.
  • Attend Trusted Process, internal and Sponsor meetings as a lead CST representative to discuss CST strategy, address CST-related agenda topics, and provide status reports.
  • Ensure CST project documentation is maintained on an ongoing basis and ensure required documentation is filed completely and accurately in the Trial Master File (TMF).
  • Identify risks and develop mitigation plan as required.
  • Participate in Sponsor, internal or agency audits and inspections, as required.
  • Responsible for management of CST scope, including identification of CST out of scope activities and overburn, including revenue recognition (if delegated this task by study lead or if serving as a Project lead in stand-alone study), invoice management (tracking and confirmation of payment), and/or KOL contract and management, etc. May participate in internal financial review meetings to review CST overburn or financial risk, as needed.
  • Plan, manage, and request CST resources (e.g., CST Project Specialist, CST Clinical Scientist, CST Assessment Scientist, etc) and provide CST resource updates for assigned projects.
  • Train and mentor internal team members.

Qualifications;


  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) level of qualification in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing or related field equivalent preferred.
  • Prior experience in study coordination, contract research organization (CRO), pharmaceutical, biotechnology or rater training vendor company preferred.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince and persuade.
  • Good organizational, planning, customer service, and time management skills with the ability to multitask under tight deadlines while providing attention to detail. Ability to manage time and work independently.
  • High level of competency in English language.
  • Proficiency with MS Office Applications.
  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/ International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to travel as necessary (up to 25%).

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Freelance LCA EXPERTS – Romania

Company Description

Bureau Veritas is a global leader in testing, inspection, and certification (TIC) services, with over 190 years of experience. We operate in more than 140 countries, supporting companies in achieving regulatory compliance, safety, and sustainability. In Romania, Bureau Veritas manages a significant portfolio of EHS/ETS audits with clients across oil & gas, energy, construction, and manufacturing sectors.

Role Description

Project Type: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) studies, Environmental Product Declarations (EPD), Carbon Footprint Analysis, Sustainability Reporting

Position Purpose:
We are seeking highly qualified LCA experts to conduct comprehensive Life Cycle Assessment studies for clients in Romania and the EU. The selected professionals will be responsible for conducting rigorous environmental assessments, managing data collection, performing impact analysis, and delivering detailed sustainability reports, operating with technical autonomy and adherence to international standards.

Main Responsibilities

  • LCA Study Execution: Conducting comprehensive Life Cycle Assessment studies in compliance with ISO 14040/14044 standards, including goal definition, scoping, inventory analysis, and impact assessment
  • Data Collection and Management: Gathering primary and secondary data from supply chains, manufacturing processes, and stakeholders; ensuring data quality and traceability
  • Life Cycle Inventory (LCI) Analysis: Developing detailed inventory models, quantifying inputs/outputs, and managing data in LCA software (SimaPro, GaBi, OpenLCA)
  • Life Cycle Impact Assessment (LCIA): Performing environmental impact calculations using recognized methodologies (ReCiPe, TRACI, CML, ILCD)
  • Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) Development: Creating EPD certifications and registrations with recognized bodies (EPD International, Product Environmental Footprint)
  • Carbon Footprint and Sustainability Reporting: Calculating greenhouse gas emissions, preparing sustainability reports, and communicating results to stakeholders
  • Scenario Analysis and Optimization: Conducting sensitivity analyses, identifying improvement opportunities, and recommending environmental mitigation strategies
  • Client Consultation and Support: Providing technical guidance, interpreting results, and supporting clients in sustainability decision-making
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring compliance with EU Environmental Footprint (EF) methodology, PEF requirements, and local environmental regulations
  • Documentation and Quality Assurance: Maintaining comprehensive project documentation, ensuring traceability, and verifying compliance with standards

Seniority Level Required

MEDIUM-HIGH LEVEL (3-5+ years of experience in LCA consulting or environmental assessment)

Required Experience Areas

  • Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
  • Environmental Product Declarations (EPD)
  • Carbon Footprint Analysis
  • Sustainability Reporting
  • Manufacturing and Supply Chain Assessment
  • Energy and Renewable Energy Sector
  • Construction and Building Materials
  • Consumer Goods and Packaging

Required Certifications

  • ISO 14040/14044 Certified LCA Practitioner (mandatory)
  • Product Environmental Footprint (PEF) Certification (preferred)
  • Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) Certification (preferred)
  • GHG Protocol Certification (preferred)
  • LCA Software Proficiency (SimaPro, GaBi, or OpenLCA – mandatory)

Similar Roles Required

  • Environmental Consultant
  • Sustainability Analyst
  • Carbon Footprint Specialist
  • Environmental Impact Assessor
  • Sustainability Reporting Specialist
  • Environmental Engineer

Requirements

Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years in LCA consulting, environmental assessment, or sustainability services
  • Proven experience conducting LCA studies for diverse sectors (manufacturing, energy, construction, consumer goods)
  • Experience with ISO 14040/14044 standard compliance
  • Knowledge of EU Environmental Footprint (EF) and Product Environmental Footprint (PEF) methodologies
  • Familiarity with supply chain environmental assessment

Technical Competencies

  • Deep knowledge of LCA methodology and ISO 14040/14044 standards
  • Proficiency in LCA software (SimaPro, GaBi, or OpenLCA)
  • Understanding of environmental impact categories (climate change, water use, resource depletion, etc.)
  • Data collection and inventory analysis expertise
  • Knowledge of environmental databases (Ecoinvent, USDA, industry-specific databases)
  • Familiarity with EPD registration and certification processes
  • Understanding of GHG Protocol and carbon accounting methodologies

Languages

  • Romanian
  • English

Required Availability

  • Type of Collaboration: Call-based activations according to shared planning

Description

SENAI is seeking an experienced VP of Sales – Europe to lead and accelerate our growth with Intelligence Agencies, Law Enforcement, Defense, and National Security organizations across Europe.

The ideal candidate is a highly autonomous, results-oriented B2G sales leader with a strong network across the European security ecosystem and a proven ability to originate, develop, and close complex, high-value government contracts.

This is a hands-on sales leadership role. We are looking for someone who can operate independently, open doors, build trusted relationships, drive opportunities forward, and close deals in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute SENAI’s European B2G sales strategy, with a primary focus on Intelligence Agencies, Law Enforcement, Defense, and National Security organizations.
  • Build and own a strategic pipeline across priority European markets, from initial prospecting and relationship building through contract signature.
  • Establish and maintain senior-level relationships with decision-makers, operational stakeholders, procurement teams, and government partners.
  • Lead complex government sales cycles, including demos, POCs, RFPs/RFIs, tenders, procurement processes, negotiations, and multi-year contracts.
  • Proactively identify new opportunities and create access to relevant government organizations and programs.
  • Identify, develop, and manage strategic relationships with local partners, integrators, distributors, and government technology partners where relevant.
  • Navigate European public-sector procurement frameworks, budget cycles, compliance requirements, and country-specific buying processes.
  • Work closely with SENAI’s Executive, Product, Presales, and Engineering teams to translate customer requirements into compelling solutions and commercial opportunities.
  • Represent SENAI at relevant European intelligence, law-enforcement, defense, and homeland-security events.
  • Own European B2G forecasting, pipeline management, pricing strategy, and revenue targets.
  • Build and scale the European B2G sales organization as the business grows.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in B2G sales, ideally within intelligence, law enforcement, defense, homeland security, cybersecurity, OSINT, data intelligence, or investigative technologies.
  • Proven experience selling directly to European Intelligence Agencies, Law Enforcement, Defense, or National Security customers.
  • Demonstrated track record of closing complex, high-value, and multi-year government contracts.
  • Strong existing network within the European intelligence, law-enforcement, defense, or security ecosystem.
  • Deep understanding of government procurement, tenders, POCs, budget cycles, and complex stakeholder environments.
  • Highly autonomous and results-oriented, with the ability to take full ownership of a territory and deliver measurable revenue outcomes.
  • Strong hunter mentality with the ability to create opportunities, open new accounts, and drive deals forward without requiring a large supporting organization.
  • Ability to move fast, prioritize effectively, and execute in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively across multiple European countries, cultures, and procurement environments.
  • Fluent English required; additional European languages are a strong advantage.
  • Willingness to travel frequently across Europe.

What Success Looks Like

Success means building SENAI into a trusted technology partner for leading European Intelligence and Law Enforcement organizations, generating significant new revenue, and creating a repeatable and scalable European B2G sales engine.

We are looking for someone who owns the number, creates momentum, and gets deals done.

What are we looking for?

Hercules is looking for a technical, inbound, SMB account executive to help us grow our paid SMB customer base.

What is our current status?

We receive 100s of inbound leads each month and have 1000s of product qualified leads. The vast majority of leads are qualified. To date we have unfortunately been turning them away. We are only 7 people and haven't had the capacity to do sales. The job is literally shooting fish in a barrel. We just need a dedicated person to do it for us!

What skills do you need?

  • Own inbound leads from qualification to close

  • Research and close product-qualified opportunities

  • Run customer discovery to understand business needs and desired outcomes

  • Lead product demos

  • Navigate security, privacy, and procurement reviews

  • Build urgency, negotiate terms, and close deals

What skills do you need?

  • Proven closing experience: 2+ years closing B2B software deals, with a track record of hitting quota

  • Technical depth: Understand data models, APIs, permissions, and integrations

  • Business software fluency: Understand applications/modules within ERPs and CRMs, the business workflows they support

  • Experience with enterprise buying requirements: Comfortable discussing SOC 2, DPAs, GDPR, security reviews etc

  • Strong communication: Clear, simple, and audience-specific communication that's tied back to business outcomes

What are Hercules’ operating principles?

Hercules’ operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of the principles can be learned on the job, however, we do specifically filter for the following principles in our hiring process:

  1. We ship. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds up our learning and delights our customers.

  2. We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We’re proud of our work.

  3. We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done.

Is Hercules in-office or remote?

Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates who are willing to 1) work in US time zones and 2) travel to the office regularly.

What are Hercules’ benefits?

  • Unlimited AI token budget

  • Take what you need vacation policy

  • Healthcare, vision, and dental

  • Daily lunches, dinners and snacks in the office

  • We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

What’s the compensation?

$125k-$250k OTE + equity (variable based on seniority, equity, and location)

🌍 We’re making security suck less for developers.

Security tools haven’t kept up with how software is built today. They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. We’re taking on legacy security tools that teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place.

Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, Aikido has $85M in the bank and a long runway ahead. We’re building toward self-securing software. Join an all-star team. Take real ownership. Push boundaries. Build things that matter.

We're looking for a Software Engineer focused on runtime security. You'll build new security capabilities for Kubernetes, Linux hosts and cloud environments, research emerging technologies and attack techniques, and ship end-to-end product features together with the product and engineering teams.

  • Build end-to-end features across Aikido's cloud security products (CSPM, Kubernetes Security, Cloud Inventory, Reachability and more)

What you can expect

  • High trust, strong values, zero corporate BS.
