raw.description:
*Candidates local to the Redmond, Washington area are desired, but the role is a remote position.


Mission

The Innovation Manager is responsible for identifying, validating, developing, and commercializing strategic growth initiatives that create meaningful new recurring revenue for MAJIQ.


Unlike traditional Product Management roles that focus on enhancing existing products, the Initiative Manager is responsible for discovering and building MAJIQ's next generation of business expansion. Acting as an internal entrepreneur, this individual identifies significant market opportunities, develops investment-ready business cases, leads customer validation, guides commercialization, and remains accountable for the initiative through its formative years until it becomes an established part of MAJIQ's business.

The Initiative Manager works across customers, industry experts, Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Leadership to transform strategic opportunities into sustainable businesses.


Why This Role Exists

MAJIQ has established a strong leadership position within the pulp and paper industry. As manufacturing continues to evolve and traditional markets mature, MAJIQ is committed to expanding into adjacent industries, new business models, and emerging technologies.

The Initiative Manager exists to identify and create the next generation of growth opportunities that will diversify MAJIQ's business and materially contribute to its long-term success.


Key Outcomes

The Initiative Manager will be expected to:

  • Identify and validate strategic growth opportunities capable of becoming significant new businesses for MAJIQ.
  • Develop investment-ready business cases supported by customer validation, market research, and financial analysis.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, prospects, industry experts, and strategic partners to uncover unmet market needs.
  • Lead early customer engagement through advisory councils, design partnerships, proofs of concept, and pilot programs.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define commercially viable Minimum Viable Products (MVPs).
  • Develop commercialization strategies including pricing, positioning, go-to-market planning, and customer adoption strategies.
  • Build reference customers and establish early market credibility.
  • Remain accountable for the commercial success and strategic direction of assigned initiatives until they mature into sustainable businesses.

Responsibilities


Opportunity Discovery

  • Identify strategic opportunities that leverage MAJIQ's strengths while expanding into adjacent markets and industries.
  • Research emerging technologies, customer challenges, competitive offerings, and market trends.
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of potential ventures at various stages of maturity.

Market Validation

  • Conduct customer discovery with existing customers, prospects, and industry experts.
  • Estimate Total Addressable Market (TAM) and Serviceable Available Market (SAM).
  • Validate customer pain points, willingness to pay, and competitive differentiation.
  • Build investment theses supported by market evidence.

Business Case Development

Develop comprehensive business cases including:

  • Market opportunity
  • Customer value proposition
  • Commercial strategy
  • Pricing model
  • Revenue projections
  • Investment requirements
  • Financial returns
  • Risks and mitigation strategies
  • Present recommendations to Executive Leadership for investment approval.

Commercialization Leadership

Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to:

  • Define MVP scope
  • Prioritize customer requirements
  • Guide commercialization strategy
  • Support product launch
  • Develop sales enablement materials
  • Build customer references
  • Measure adoption and market success

Venture Leadership

Serve as the business owner for assigned initiatives by:

  • Monitoring commercial performance
  • Gathering ongoing customer feedback
  • Recommending strategic pivots when appropriate
  • Expanding market opportunities
  • Transitioning mature initiatives into MAJIQ's core business portfolio


Success Measures

Success will be measured by:

  • Quality and strategic value of opportunities identified
  • Customer validation achieved
  • Strength of investment recommendations
  • Successful commercialization of new initiatives
  • Customer adoption and market acceptance
  • Strategic contribution to MAJIQ's long-term growth
  • Creation of sustainable recurring revenue businesses
  • Development of reference customers and new market presence

Core Competencies


WORKING WITH AI – DEVELOPING WITH AI

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

Entrepreneurial Mindset

Naturally identifies opportunities, embraces uncertainty, and demonstrates the initiative required to build something from the ground up.

Commercial Acumen

Understands how businesses create value through customer needs, pricing strategies, recurring revenue models, and profitable growth.

Strategic Thinking

Recognizes emerging market opportunities and develops long-term growth strategies aligned with MAJIQ's vision.

Customer Obsession

Builds deep relationships with customers and seeks to understand operational challenges before proposing solutions.



Financial & Analytical Skills

Develops sound business cases supported by market analysis, financial modeling, and data-driven decision making.


Influence & Leadership

Builds alignment across cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority.


Bias for Action

Moves quickly from concept to validation while maintaining disciplined decision-making.


Resilience

Thrives in ambiguity, adapts to changing market conditions, and learns quickly from both successes and setbacks.


Qualifications

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Operations, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in product management, business development, strategy, operations, manufacturing technology, enterprise software, consulting, or entrepreneurial ventures.
  • Demonstrated experience bringing new products, services, or businesses to market.
  • Experience developing business cases, market analyses, and commercialization strategies.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25–40%.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial business builder who enjoys creating new businesses rather than managing mature ones.

Successful candidates may come from enterprise software, manufacturing, consulting, startups, operations leadership, or corporate innovation. We value individuals who have demonstrated curiosity, resilience, commercial judgment, and the ability to transform ideas into successful businesses.

This role requires someone who is equally comfortable speaking with customers, developing financial models, presenting investment recommendations to executives, and working alongside product and engineering teams to bring new ventures to market.

Exempt

Salary Range:

The estimated base salary range for this role is USD$135,000.00 - USD$165,000.00 per year. We include salary ranges in job postings only where required by applicable pay transparency laws, based on the jurisdictions in which the role may be performed. The posted range is a good faith estimate and reflects factors that are subject to change. Final offer amounts may vary based on job-related factors, including work location, candidate experience and expertise, and other relevant considerations.

Other Compensation (US Only):

This role will also be eligible for participation in a Company profit sharing bonus plan. Plan details will be provided to you upon hire.

Benefits (US Only):

Full time employees will also be eligible for enrollment in a wide range of choices of benefits , including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, short/long term disability, 401(k) participation (with company match).

The Company provides a minimum of 10 days of vacation for new employees , sick time based on state requirements, 8 Company-paid holidays and 2 personal holidays per year.We recognize the value and importance of diversity and inclusion in our communities and in the workplace. raw.description:
Thriveworks is currently seeking Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners in New Hampshire.

***Clinicians need to be licensed and living in the state in which they will be practicing.***

Compensation: This is a Fee for Service (W2) position, the range for this position is $71,000-$102,000 per year based on 15-20 clinical hours per week.

To maintain safety and best practices for our clinicians and patients via telemedicine, Thriveworks does not push or incentivize the use of stimulant medications; instead, we offer them as an option based on the client’s specific symptoms and diagnosis, with prescribing decisions left to the discretion of the clinician. We do not currently treat substance use disorders, and make every effort to refer out to an in-person provider when symptoms arise that are too severe to be treated via telemedicine only.

Thriveworks Nurse Practitioners are expected to provide care to a diverse population of clients with mental health conditions such as depression, anxiety, ADHD, and more. They work with a broad range of age groups, primarily adults and adolescents, with a future focus on expanding care across the lifespan.

Qualifications:

  • Licensed Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner - Board Certification required

  • Master's in Nursing with active prescriptive authority required in the state

  • Understanding of AdvancedMD (AMD) EMR is a plus

  • Three years of experience is a plus; 1 year of psychiatry practice is required

  • Licensed Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners need to be licensed and live in the state in which they will be practicing

  • Part-time requires 15 - 20 hours of availability per week

  • All clinicians are required to complete an in-house training on our ADHD treatment standards, guidelines, and approach, followed by a brief exam. While all new hires are enrolled in the ADHD Clinic and expected to accept and treat ADHD clients, there are no quotas for the number of clients or prescriptions.

What We Need:

  • Make Psychiatric assessments and evaluations of clients in an ongoing telemedicine capacity

  • Willingness to treat 14 years old and up

  • Prescribe medication to reduce mental health symptoms, as needed

  • Create and collaborate with clients on care plans

  • Complete and/or administer appropriate paperwork and assessment tools for clients

  • Adhere to Thriveworks' Clinical Practice Guidelines

  • Consult with Regional Clinic Directors and staff on clients, programs, and services at the various sites

What We Give:

We are dedicated to taking great care of our employees and empowering them to succeed. This enables them to focus on providing excellent care to our clients. We offer the following benefits:

  • Fully Remote

  • Remote Medical Assistants

  • Guaranteed, bi-weekly pay (no need to wait on reimbursement)

  • 401K with 3% employer match

  • Paid orientation and annual pay increases

  • Flexible scheduling (Sessions are available from 7 am–10 pm, 7 days/week)

  • Paid orientation, Paid Credentialing, Paid Malpractice Coverage, In-house professional development, including case consultation groups

  • Annual pay increases and Bonus Opportunities

  • Schedule Flexibility with No Show Protection and No required on-call

  • Amazing team culture and clinical support

Who we are - about Thriveworks:

Thriveworks is a trusted mental health provider with 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model. We serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and these numbers continue to grow. As a clinician-founded and clinician-led organization, we offer the tools, support, and community you need to build a fulfilling, long-term career.

A career at Thriveworks isn’t just about finding a job that pays the bills. It’s about helping others, joining a community, and learning to thrive both personally and professionally. We believe that the success of our employees is just as important as the success of our organization; they go hand in hand.

So, what do you say? Are you interested in joining our team? Apply today.


Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!


With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

  • Our recruiters and other team members will only email you from or an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our recruiters and other team members may also contact you via text or phone to schedule an interview.
  • A google meets interview invitation will be sent via email and will only come from an @thriveworks.com email address.
  • Our interviews will take place over Google Meet (not Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or any other platform).
  • We will never ask you to purchase or send us equipment.

If you see a scam related to Thriveworks, please report it to . You can contact with any questions or concerns.


Thriveworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our people are our most valuable assets. We embrace and encourage differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We encourage and welcome diverse candidates to apply for any position you are qualified for to bring your unique perspective to our team.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship, either now or in the future.

By clicking Apply, you acknowledge that Thriveworks may contact you regarding your application.

raw.description:
German-Speaking Affiliate Manager

Full-time, Remote (GMT+0 to GMT+4)

About Us
At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company
You'll be joining a fast-growing European cashback and savings platform that helps consumers save money when they shop online, through its website, weekly newsletter and browser extension. The company works with hundreds of shops, brands and fintechs, mostly across the DACH region, through major affiliate networks as well as direct partnerships. With a large and engaged weekly newsletter audience, partner revenue is central to how the business grows.

The Role
As a German-Speaking Affiliate Manager, you will own the company's affiliate partner and network relationships, sell paid placements on the website and newsletter, and bring in new partners that pay well for high-quality traffic. This is a hands-on affiliate role for someone who already knows the field. You'll price and negotiate deals yourself and escalate only the big decisions.

The client is looking for someone with proven affiliate marketing experience who can hit the ground running with minimal training. This is not an entry point into affiliate marketing or a career-change role. You'll be speaking with German-speaking partners every day, on calls and in writing, and working during DACH business hours.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the partnership inbox and respond quickly to partners and networks on offer requests, commission and tracking questions, and traffic or fraud queries

  • Build and maintain a media kit, then sell and book website placements and weekly newsletter slots

  • Negotiate better terms with existing partners, including higher CPA or CPS rates, exclusive codes and bonus commissions, especially ahead of Black Friday and Q4

  • Bring in new shops, brands and fintechs through affiliate networks and direct deals, focusing on high-basket and high-commission verticals

  • Track partner performance across clicks, conversion, EPC, basket size, commission and rejection rates, and flag underperformers

  • Report weekly on placement revenue, pipeline, top and bottom partners, and open issues

  • Use AI tools to manage inbox volume and speed up media kits and reporting

Ideal Candidate

  • Proven, hands-on experience in affiliate marketing is a must, from the publisher, network or advertiser side

  • Direct experience managing affiliate partner and network relationships, including day-to-day communication on offers, tracking and commissions

  • Working knowledge of commission models (CPA, CPS, CPC, CPL) and affiliate performance metrics such as EPC, conversion and rejection rates, with no training needed on the fundamentals

  • A track record of pricing, negotiating and closing affiliate deals or paid placements independently

  • Native or fully fluent German, as most partners and networks are in the DACH region, plus good English

  • Based in GMT+0 to GMT+4 and comfortable working during DACH business hours

  • Ready to take ownership from day one and deliver results without hand-holding

  • Self-driven and organised, able to manage a busy inbox and pipeline independently in a remote setup

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a cashback, coupon, deal or comparison site, or at an affiliate network such as Awin, Adcell, CJ or financeAds

  • Experience in e-commerce or fintech affiliate programmes

  • Awareness of the reputational sensitivity around cashback and coupon browser extensions

Tools & Stack
Affiliate networks (Awin, Adcell, CJ, financeAds), Affiliate tracking and reporting dashboards, ChatGPT and other AI tools

Join Our Team
Be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where your technical skills and product instincts can make a real impact. We offer competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, and a supportive remote work culture. Apply now and take the next step in your career.

At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they happen to be born in.

raw.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About the Role

Forbes Advisor is looking for a Paid Search Strategist to join the Forbes Advisor Performance Marketing team, supporting Forbes Advisor's Financial Services business.

This role is responsible for driving the strategic direction and long-term growth of key paid search categories. The ideal candidate combines deep SEM expertise with strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence stakeholders across the organization. They will identify new opportunities, develop scalable growth strategies, champion innovation, and serve as a key driver of business outcomes across their owned verticals.

If you're looking for challenges and opportunities similar to those of a start-up, with the benefits of an established, successful company, read on.

The Paid Search Strategist will own category growth, shape roadmap priorities, influence cross-functional initiatives, and work closely with publishers, Product, Business Development, Data, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, and leadership teams to unlock new opportunities and drive meaningful business results.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Growth

  • Own the strategic direction, growth plans, and commercial success of key categories.
  • Develop and execute short-term and long-term growth strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Build clear category roadmaps that balance immediate performance opportunities with long-term capability development.
  • Identify, prioritize, and champion high-impact initiatives that drive sustained growth and competitive advantage.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for owned categories, proactively identifying market trends, opportunities, and risks.
  • Influence performance beyond directly owned accounts through thought leadership, best-practice development, and cross-category initiatives.
  • Generate innovative ideas that challenge existing approaches and establish new best practices across the organization.
  • Evaluate emerging industry trends, platform developments, and product innovations to maintain competitive advantage.

Performance Ownership

  • Take full ownership of category performance, including revenue, profitability, volume, efficiency, and growth targets.
  • Drive category growth through data-driven decision making and strategic allocation of resources.
  • Develop forecasting models and growth plans for owned categories, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Analyze performance trends, identify root causes of variance, and communicate strategic recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and account audits to identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.
  • Utilize advanced analytical approaches to identify growth opportunities across campaigns, audiences, funnels, landing experiences, and partner ecosystems.

Innovation & Testing

  • Design and own testing frameworks that support strategic category growth.
  • Identify, prioritize, and scale innovative PPC tactics, automation opportunities, audience expansion strategies, and emerging platform capabilities.
  • Drive experimentation initiatives from conception through implementation and performance evaluation.
  • Build strong hypotheses based on data, market insights, and business needs to unlock new growth opportunities.
  • Scale successful initiatives across additional categories and share learnings broadly within the organization.
  • Partner directly with publishers and platform representatives to leverage beta programs, product innovations, and new capabilities.

Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong relationships with Business Development, Product, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Analytics, and Leadership teams.
  • Influence stakeholders and obtain buy-in for strategic initiatives through compelling data, analysis, and business cases.
  • Partner with Business Development teams to identify new partner opportunities, market expansion opportunities, and monetization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to identify and prioritize enhancements that improve business performance.
  • Present category performance, growth strategies, recommendations, and insights to senior stakeholders and leadership audiences.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor and thought leader within the Performance Marketing team.

Capability Expectations

  • Operates with high levels of autonomy and limited oversight.
  • Owns category strategy and growth as if managing their own business.
  • Develops and drives initiatives that influence performance beyond directly managed accounts.
  • Proactively identifies opportunities and challenges before they impact performance.
  • Leads strategic projects with significant business impact.
  • Creates clear vision, roadmap, and execution plans for owned categories.
  • Builds alignment across multiple stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
  • Balances commercial performance with long-term strategic investments.
  • Drives adoption of new ideas, processes, and best practices across the wider team.
  • Acts as a trusted strategic partner to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Professional Competencies

  • Deep passion for search marketing and digital advertising.
  • Strategic thinker with a forward-looking mindset and strong commercial awareness.
  • Proven ability to identify growth opportunities and convert them into measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to make decisions using incomplete information.
  • Outstanding analytical and critical thinking abilities.
  • Ability to influence and negotiate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving change.
  • Ability to connect market dynamics, business objectives, and performance marketing strategies.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.
  • Growth mindset with a focus on continuous learning and innovation.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in Paid Search / SEM, including extensive experience with Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
  • Proven track record of owning and growing large-scale PPC programs.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing long-term growth strategies that drive measurable business impact.
  • Advanced understanding of Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, automation, smart bidding strategies, and audience targeting.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen is seeking a highly technical and execution-oriented Applied AI Scientist to design, develop, deploy, and optimize AI-powered solutions that solve meaningful business challenges. In this role, you will partner with business, product, engineering, and technology teams to identify opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and deliver production-ready AI capabilities.

You will combine expertise in machine learning, generative AI, software development, and experimentation to create scalable AI systems that improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder who enjoys solving complex problems and translating emerging AI technologies into measurable business value.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions from proof of concept through production.
  • Partner with business and product stakeholders to identify use cases, define objectives, and measure impact.
  • Build solutions leveraging machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), NLP, predictive analytics, and agentic workflows.
  • Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to ensure solution quality, accuracy, reliability, and performance.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to operationalize AI solutions using MLOps and LLMOps best practices.
  • Contribute reusable code, tools, models, and frameworks that accelerate AI adoption across the enterprise.
  • Stay current on emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative approaches to business challenges.
  • Contribute to technical best practices and knowledge sharing across the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in applied AI, machine learning, data science, or a related field.
  • Experience developing and deploying production AI or machine learning solutions.
  • Strong expertise in machine learning, statistics, predictive modeling, experimentation, and analytics.
  • Experience building solutions utilizing LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, and modern AI frameworks.
  • Proficiency in Python and common AI/ML toolsets such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, MLflow, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms and production software environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience working in cross-functional agile teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience implementing Responsible AI and AI governance practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale AI initiatives.

Description

The Senior Manager of Tufin’s Enterprise Business Systems team serves as both the architect and coach behind our enterprise applications strategy—leading the design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of the systems that power our go-to-market, finance, procurement, and quality operations.

You will lead a global team of business analysts, system administrators, and developers responsible for the full lifecycle of enterprise business applications—from requirements and design through configuration, development, testing, deployment, and long-term support

What You’ll Do…

Enterprise Systems Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and own the enterprise business systems strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligning GTM, finance, quality systems with company objectives and Enterprise Technology strategy.
  • Architect scalable, secure, and compliant technical ecosystems that support rapid growth and global operations
  • Champion automation, AI-enabled workflows, and process simplification to reduce manual effort and improve operational velocity.
  • Orchestrate integrations across Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, NetSuite, Jira, and other enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow and end-to-end visibility, simplifying the end-user experience
  • Define and uphold data governance, system architecture, and security standards to ensure accuracy, consistency, and trust in enterprise data.
  • Partner closely with analytics and data teams to ensure systems are optimized for reporting, forecasting, and data warehouse initiatives.
  • Design and implement a continuous improvement function for the Enterprise Business Systems team focused on eliminating work that could be automated or executed through the deployment of AI.

End-to-End Application Lifecycle Ownership

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of enterprise applications—from documentation and design through configuration, development, testing, implementation, and production support.
  • Ensure high-quality system delivery through strong standards, validation practices, testing discipline, and post-launch support models.
  • Prioritize enhancements, fixes, and new capabilities based on business impact, risk, urgency, and resource availability.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as a trusted advisor and primary liaison between Enterprise Technology and business stakeholders across Tufin’s customer-facing and back-office teams.
  • Ability to lead / lead your team through requirements gathering, workshops, and solution design sessions—translating business needs into scalable technical solutions where appropriate.
  • Serve as functional relationship owner, ensuring systems continuously evolve with business needs.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of business system analysts, developers, and system administrators.
  • Set clear objectives, provide coaching and technical guidance, conduct performance reviews, and support long-term career development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Delivery, Change & Adoption

  • Lead large, cross-functional enterprise initiatives with competing priorities, ensuring projects stay on track and meet milestones.
  • Drive change management, training, documentation, and communication strategies to ensure strong user adoption.
  • Ensure systems comply with internal policies, data governance standards, security requirements, and external regulations (e.g., SOX, ISO, etc.)

Requirements

Who You Are…

  • 8+ years of experience in Enterprise Business Systems, Revenue Operations, IT Applications, or Business Technology within SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience leading the implementation, configuration, development, and support of complex enterprise platforms (e.g., Salesforce, CPQ, ERP, Atlassian, etc.).
  • 4+ years of people management experience, including direct reports, performance management, and team development.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, matrixed, cross-functional initiatives.

Technical & Functional Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce ecosystems (Sales, Service, and Experience Clouds, CPQ), iPaaS platforms (Boomi, Workato, n8n, etc.), and with ERP platforms such as NetSuite.
  • Experience with system integrations, APIs/ETL, workflow automation, and enterprise data architectures.
  • Strong business analysis and product ownership skills, with experience translating requirements into technical solutions.
  • Hands-on technical background (configuration and/or coding) sufficient to coach teams and guide solution design.

Leadership & Delivery Skills

  • Strong strategic mindset with the ability to translate business strategy into scalable systems and roadmaps.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills; ability to speak both “business” and “technical.”
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong change management, documentation, and training experience.
  • Certifications such as PMP, CSM, Salesforce, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus

The primary objectives of the position are to enroll customers in service contracts, sell products over the phone, and generate leads for the Strategic Account Managers. The Special Market Account Manager will build strong relationships with their customer base through a regular cadence of communication to ensure that they stay on their service contracts. raw.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Partner Manager to help drive growth across the DACH public sector landscape. The successful candidate will be responsible for acquiring and developing new partnerships with resellers, system integrators, and consultancies serving federal, state, and municipal government, education, and other public institutions — while ensuring existing partnerships are nurtured and maintained. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in partner management or business development within the public sector, and a strong understanding of DACH public procurement dynamics.

How you will contribute to our success:

  • Identify and prospect new partnerships with resellers, system integrators, and consultancies with established access to public sector accounts across DACH.

  • Develop relationships with key stakeholders in potential partner organizations and maintain ongoing communication to ensure successful partnerships.

  • Navigate and support partners through public procurement processes (tenders, framework agreements, RFPs) to maximize joint pipeline conversion.

  • Continuously monitor and analyze partnership performance, identifying areas for improvement and implementing strategies to maximize results.

  • Negotiate and close partnership agreements with potential partners, ensuring terms are favorable to both parties and compliant with public sector procurement requirements.

  • Manage existing partnerships, ensuring ongoing communication and effective collaboration to drive growth and value for both parties.

  • Stay up to date with public sector industry trends, regulatory developments (e.g., cybersecurity compliance mandates, NIS2), competitive landscapes, and market conditions to identify new opportunities.

What sets you apart:

  • At least 3 years of experience in partner management or business development, with a focus on the DACH public sector (federal, state, municipal, or education).

  • Proven track record of acquiring and developing successful partnerships with public-sector-facing resellers, SIs, or consultancies.

  • Familiarity with public procurement processes and frameworks (tenders, RFPs, framework agreements) in Germany, Austria, and/or Switzerland.

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including within long, multi-stakeholder public sector sales cycles.

  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently, as well as part of a team.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Fluent in German and English, or with additional languages such as Spanish, French and Dutch being a plus.

  • Working knowledge of AI tools, capabilities, and limitations, with the ability to translate them into practical partner and customer value.

We look for individuals who embody these core attributes:

  • Growth Mindset: Takes full ownership of setbacks and proactively seeks feedback as the fastest route to improvement.

  • Curiosity: Possesses an intrinsic drive to understand the business beyond their own role and challenges the status quo with evidence.

  • Operational Impact: Focuses on measurable business outcomes by ruthlessly prioritizing results and cutting through complexity.

  • Grit: Persists through genuine obstacles and ambitious goals, finding a way forward when there isn't an obvious path.

  • Clear Communicator: Delivers punchy, professional, and structured communication that always leads with the "why."

  • Respectful of Others: Demonstrates professional maturity by assuming positive intent and prioritizing constructive honesty over artificial harmony.

  • Technological Edge: Thinks in first principles to automate work and translate complex technology into scalable business solutions.

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position

The Director, Strategic Partnerships will lead the growth, retention, operational execution, and strategic expansion of Teladoc Health’s commercial partnership relationships across employer benefit consultants, national brokers, health plans, healthcare engagement organizations, and other strategic channel partners. This role is responsible for developing and executing annual partner strategies, supporting national partnership agreements, communicating partner pricing and performance terms, advancing data sharing processes, leading partner education, supporting client retention, and identifying partner-influenced revenue opportunities. The Director will serve as a senior liaison between Teladoc Health and key partners, working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Clinical, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Implementation, Reporting, Data Science, Client Success, and Health Plan teams to advance shared business priorities, strengthen partner satisfaction, improve internal alignment, and support revenue and margin goals. The ideal candidate is a strategic, consultative leader with expert knowledge of the employer healthcare benefits ecosystem, strong commercial judgment, operational discipline, public speaking strength, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow strategic partner relationships with employee benefit consultants, and national brokers.
  • Develop and maintain annual partner strategies, operating calendars, forecasts, account maps, executive engagement plans, business reviews, and stewardship meetings.
  • Support national partnership agreements, including pricing, referral fees, performance guarantees, preferred terms, contract review, renewals, and execution in partnership with Legal, Finance, Sales, and leadership.
  • Establish and enhance partner data sharing processes, including partner warehouse requirements, partner presentations, and internal coordination with data, reporting, privacy, and operations teams.
  • Maintain and communicate national partnership terms, including referral fee eligibility, data sharing, performance guarantees, preferred pricing, partner matrix updates, and pricing revisions.
  • Build expert-level relationships across partner executive, regional, clinical, pharmacy, wellbeing, digital health, population health, analytics, account management, and local market teams.
  • Lead partner engagement through in-person events, consultant education, sales enablement sessions, webinars with partner subject matter experts, and client or prospect seminars.
  • Partner with Sales, Client Success, Health Plan owners, and other commercial leaders to support new business, renewals, expansions, RFP/RFI responses, prospect huddles, and partner-influenced pipeline.
  • Support client retention and account resolution efforts with BenCon involvement, including keep meetings, escalations, and follow-through with the appropriate internal owners.
  • Drive revenue growth, margin performance, and partner satisfaction while operating within company budget, pricing, contract, and compliance parameters.
  • Translate partner priorities, market feedback, consultant insights, competitive intelligence, and win/loss learnings into strategies that inform sales enablement, product positioning, commercialization, and market development.
  • Use reporting, analytics, Salesforce, scorecards, partner feedback, pipeline data, and book-of-business insights to assess performance, maintain data accuracy, and make fact-based recommendations.
  • Maintain Salesforce, SharePoint, Highspot, partner overviews, event tracking, partner communications, and Strategic Partnerships book-of-business resources.
  • Educate internal teams on BenCon partnerships, partner programs, market positioning, partnership requirements, and best practices.
  • Contribute to Strategic Partnerships team standards, operating processes, internal communications, project ownership, cross-functional workstreams, and internal marketing of the function.
  • Represent Teladoc Health in strategic partner meetings, national conferences, marketing-sponsored events, industry forums, consultant education sessions, and executive-level discussions.
  • Demonstrate expert knowledge of Teladoc Health products, employer benefits, healthcare purchasing, virtual care, chronic condition management, wellbeing, health plan dynamics, competitive landscape, and relevant market trends.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role is expected to serve as a leader within the Strategic Partnerships team. Responsibilities may include mentoring associates or account executives, coordinating matrixed workstreams, contributing best practices in team meetings, leading cross-functional initiatives, developing team standards and processes, and representing Strategic Partnerships in senior internal and external forums. Direct people management responsibilities may include managing associate-level team members or other direct reports based on business needs and organizational structure.


Qualifications Expected for Position

  • 9-12 or more years of direct industry experience in strategic partnerships, employer benefits, benefits consulting, broker relations, healthcare sales, account management, channel development, or a related commercial healthcare role.
  • Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree in business, public health, healthcare administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Expert-level understanding of the employer healthcare benefits market, including consultants, brokers, health plans, employers, population health strategies, virtual care, chronic condition management, wellbeing, and digital health solutions.
  • Expert Teladoc Health product knowledge, with the ability to train partners, educate internal teams, and clarify product positioning in a way that is plain, differentiated, and market-ready.
  • Proven ability to manage complex strategic relationships, develop annual partner strategies, lead business reviews, and drive measurable revenue growth, retention, and partner satisfaction.
  • Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to build credibility, influence senior leaders, facilitate alignment, and lead consultative discussions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, public speaking, and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for internal and external audiences.
  • Strong strategic selling skills, including the ability to identify opportunities, shape partner strategy, negotiate within company parameters, and drive action across a matrixed organization.
  • Strong analytical and process-driven mindset, including the ability to use data, reporting, Salesforce, scorecards, partner feedback, pipeline trends, and market insights to inform recommendations.
  • Demonstrated project ownership, change management, and process improvement skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with customers, partners, senior leaders, cross-functional colleagues, and matrixed teams.
  • Strong internal networking skills and ability to act as a brand ambassador for Teladoc Health and the Strategic Partnerships team.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Highspot, and related business communication and enablement tools.
  • Demonstrated emotional intelligence, active listening, empathy, coaching, feedback, organization, resourcefulness, innovation, and strategic vision.
  • Commitment to ongoing industry knowledge and professional development.
  • 20% travel required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly with national consulting firms, regional brokers, health plans, or large employer clients.
  • Experience commercializing healthcare, virtual care, chronic condition management, wellbeing, or digital health solutions.
  • Experience developing partner strategy, executive briefings, consultant education, market feedback recaps, or partner-specific sales enablement materials.
  • Experience working in a remote, matrixed, high-growth, or technology-enabled healthcare environment.

The base salary range for this position is $105,000 - $125,000. raw.description:
WorkBetterNow () provides full-time positions for professionals in LATAM looking to work with United States-based companies. Our remote professionals come first and are the most important part of our team. If you want to be part of a company that values work-life balance and supports your professional development, you’re in the right place.

Our Core Values
  • Put our Talent first
  • Pursuit of excellence/continuous learning
  • Integrity and transparency
  • Ownership mentality
  • Growth mindset
  • Excellent attitude
The Ideal Candidate
You have advanced English proficiency at a C1 or C2 level and value work-life balance and remote flexibility. You take ownership of your work, communicate with integrity, and bring a great attitude to everything you do. You are genuinely excited about continuous learning and are looking for long-term commitment and stability. Most importantly, you align with our core values and want to grow professionally with a supportive team that truly puts you first.

Job Description

A remote Estimator Assistant will support the estimation team in preparing accurate cost estimates and project bids. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and familiarity with construction materials, takeoffs, and pricing. While your duties will depend on the specific needs of your client, they will include, but not be limited to:
  • Assist in preparing cost estimates, bids, and proposals for construction projects.
  • Perform quantity takeoffs from plans, blueprints, and specifications.
  • Review drawings and project documents to identify scope requirements.
  • Collect, compare, and organize pricing from vendors and subcontractors.
  • Maintain and update cost databases, material pricing, and labor rates.
  • Support the preparation and submission of bid packages.
  • Assist in scope analysis to ensure all project components are included.
  • Track bid deadlines and ensure timely submissions.
  • Prepare estimation reports and summaries for internal review.
  • Coordinate with project managers and estimators to clarify project details.
  • Identify potential cost-saving opportunities or risks.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of all estimation data.

Requirements

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Construction, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2+ years of proven experience in estimating or construction support roles.
  • Familiarity with takeoff tools such as Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or similar.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Excel and estimation tools.
Technical Requirements
  • Processor: Intel 11th Gen (or AMD Ryzen 5000 series) for Windows | M2 for Macs.
  • RAM: 16 GB minimum.
  • Internet: Stable connection of 50 Mbps minimum.
Please note that devices such as MacBook Neos and Chromebooks are not fit for our roles.

Benefits

Compensation & Growth
At WorkBetterNow, we believe in rewarding commitment and supporting long-term success. Our pay structure ensures your compensation evolves with your experience and tenure. Note: The figures below reflect our 2026 ranges; each tenure milestone will increase each year.
  • 0-3 months: $1,200 USD/month
  • After 3 months: You’ll receive a $50 monthly Wellness Bonus to support a healthy and balanced work life (total: $1,250/month).
  • After 1 year: Salary increases to $1,340 USD/month
  • After 2 years: Salary increases to $1,480 USD/month
  • After 3 years: Salary increases to $1,540 USD/month
  • After 4 years: Salary increases to $1,600 USD/month
Two Annual Adjustments: Every year, you benefit from two salary increases: one on your work anniversary, recognizing your continued tenure with WorkBetterNow, and one at the start of each calendar year, when all salary ranges are updated company-wide.

Benefits & Perks
  • 100% remote work — enjoy the comfort and flexibility of working from home
  • 18 paid vacation days + U.S. federal holidays
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave (up to 2 months with 50% salary coverage after 1 year)
  • Client Growth Bonus: Your great work helps our clients scale. For every new hire added to the business you support, you will receive a $50 one-time reward. It’s our way of celebrating the growth you helped make possible.
  • A dedicated Talent Coordinator who serves as your guide and liaison between you, WorkBetterNow, and your assigned company—helping you navigate your role and continue growing professionally.
  • A supportive, people-first environment where your voice matters.

Founded in 2012 by 3 expert hackers with no investment capital, Trail of Bits is the premier place for security experts to boldly advance security and address technology’s newest and most challenging risks. Our combination of novel research with practical solutions reduces the security risks that our clients face from emerging technologies. Cybersecurity preparedness is a moving target. Companies like ours are the tip of the spear in the fight against attackers. Our research-based and custom-engineering approach ensures that our client’s capabilities are at the forefront of what’s available. For companies and technologies that live and die by their security, a proactive, tailored approach is required to keep one step ahead of attackers.

When you apply, you'll be added to our newsletter so you can stay updated on company news and opportunities. You can opt out anytime.

raw.title: Analista de Seguridad de la Información – Gestión de Alertas DLP
raw.excerpt: Objetivo del cargoTrabajar con el equipo de Seguridad de la Información de SURA Colombia en la revisión e investigación de las alertas generadas por la solución DLP ya implementada.
raw.description:
Objetivo del cargo

Trabajar con el equipo de Seguridad de la Información de SURA Colombia en la revisión e investigación de las alertas generadas por la solución DLP ya implementada. Su función principal será entender el contexto de negocio de cada evento: determinar si la actividad hace parte de un flujo legítimo, si corresponde mantenerla bloqueada o si requiere una revisión adicional. A partir de sus hallazgos, coordinará con el equipo de seguridad y el proveedor los ajustes que sean necesarios.

Responsabilidades principales

  • Revisar, clasificar y dar seguimiento a las alertas generadas por la herramienta DLP.
  • Analizar cada caso desde el proceso de negocio: qué información se utilizó, quién realizó la acción, con qué propósito y si esa actividad está autorizada.
  • Contactar a los usuarios y responsables de los procesos para levantar el contexto de las alertas y validar si corresponden a flujos habituales del negocio.
  • Identificar falsos positivos, actividades legítimas que requieren revisión de las reglas y eventos que deben mantenerse bloqueados o escalarse al equipo de seguridad.
  • Documentar las entrevistas, evidencias, decisiones y justificaciones de cada caso.
  • Consolidar los hallazgos y presentar al proveedor solicitudes claras de revisión o ajuste de reglas, en coordinación con el equipo de Seguridad de la Información.
  • Hacer seguimiento a los cambios realizados y validar, con las áreas involucradas, si las alertas o bloqueos reflejan adecuadamente el flujo del negocio.
  • Identificar alertas recurrentes y proponer mejoras que ayuden a reducir el ruido operativo sin perder visibilidad sobre posibles riesgos

Perfil requerido

Profesional en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Administración, Ingeniería Industrial o áreas afines, con experiencia en seguridad de la información, análisis de procesos o gestión de alertas DLP. Se requiere capacidad para investigar casos, conversar con usuarios, comprender procesos de negocio y sustentar conclusiones con evidencia.

Buscamos una persona de nivel pleno, con criterio analítico, comunicación clara y capacidad de coordinación entre negocio, Seguridad de la Información y proveedor. Debe comprender el propósito de una solución DLP y la lógica general de sus alertas y bloqueos, pero no se requiere un especialista dedicado a configurar o administrar técnicamente la herramienta.

Conocimientos y experiencia

  • Experiencia en seguridad de la información, análisis de procesos o gestión de alertas DLP.
  • Comprensión de la protección de información sensible, los controles DLP y la gestión de casos.
  • Capacidad para analizar evidencias y traducir una necesidad del negocio en un requerimiento claro para el equipo técnico o el proveedor.
  • Experiencia trabajando con usuarios, áreas de negocio y equipos de tecnología o seguridad.

Habilidades requeridas

  • Gestión y seguimiento: organizar los casos, priorizar según su impacto y asegurar que cada alerta tenga una conclusión y un cierre documentado.
  • Responsabilidad y atención al detalle: tratar la información con reserva, verificar los hechos antes de concluir y mantener la trazabilidad de las decisiones.
  • Proactividad: detectar patrones, alertas recurrentes y oportunidades de mejora sin esperar únicamente a que se le asignen casos.
  • Comunicación clara y empática: conversar con usuarios sobre sus actividades sin asumir que una alerta implica una conducta indebida; formular preguntas precisas y explicar los hallazgos de forma sencilla.
  • Escucha activa y criterio de negocio: comprender cómo trabajan las áreas para distinguir un flujo legítimo de una situación que requiere control o escalamiento.
  • Pensamiento analítico: relacionar la alerta con el contexto, las evidencias y las políticas aplicables antes de recomendar una acción.
  • Coordinación entre equipos: gestionar conversaciones y compromisos con usuarios, responsables de proceso, Seguridad de la Información y proveedor.
  • Autonomía y sentido de urgencia: avanzar en las investigaciones, solicitar la información faltante y escalar oportunamente los casos relevantes.

raw.description:
About Lumistry

Lumistry serves over 9,000 pharmacies globally, helping them transform their businesses to improve adherence, reduce operating costs and increase revenue. We offer a collection of solutions purpose-built for pharmacies, enabling our customers to engage with their patients, consolidate vendors, improve patient health literacy, automate tasks and initiate online scheduling for programs and services. For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

As a Digital Implementation Specialist, you'll build, review, test, and launch the websites and digital products our pharmacy customers rely on. Your job is to make sure every site is accurate, functional, polished, and ready for launch. You'll also keep Digital operations running day to day, from setting up domain-based email to handling product teardowns. You'll do well if you love details, take ownership, and keep work moving without lowering the bar. You'll find and fix issues, improve our processes, and look for ways to make Lumistry's Digital products easier to use and better for customers. Our goal is for every Digital product and service to be delivered accurately, consistently, and at the quality our customers expect.

What You'll Own

Website Delivery and Support

  • Build and deploy customer websites in Replit, following Lumistry standards, build processes, and customer requirements.
  • Review completed builds for visual accuracy, layout consistency, and content quality, and make adjustments as needed.
  • Migrate content, imagery, services, and functionality from customers' existing websites, and resolve anything missing or inconsistent before launch.
  • Test functionality and responsiveness on desktop and mobile, including navigation, links, forms, integrations, and other interactive elements.
  • Hold every site to our QA standards while finding ways to improve design, usability, accessibility, and the visitor experience.
  • Support enterprise and non-enterprise projects, including large-scale website migrations and other Digital initiatives.
  • Help create, test, and improve website templates, standards, and build resources.
  • Meet production goals, timelines, quality expectations, and SLAs.

Digital Operations and Cross-Functional Support

  • Create and configure domain-based Google email inboxes for customers during onboarding and ongoing support.
  • Monitor and complete Digital teardown requests so websites and their associated services are properly disconnected or removed.
  • Identify and escalate blockers, dependencies, or issues that could affect customer timelines or service delivery.
  • Monitor your assigned Salesforce queues so requests keep moving and SLAs are met.
  • Maintain internal documentation and support cross-functional onboarding and training on Digital products and processes.
  • Take part in audits, migrations, and special projects as assigned by Digital leadership.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Bring

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating, editing, or maintaining websites
  • Experience using AI-powered tools, and real comfort adopting new technology
  • Strong attention to detail, with an eye for visual, content, and functional inconsistencies
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, queues, and priorities at once
  • Ability to troubleshoot problems and learn new technical tools and processes on your own
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, evolving environment
  • A track record of meeting deadlines and production and service-level expectations
  • Ability to collaborate across technical and customer-facing teams

Preferred

  • Experience with Replit and Salesforce
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards, responsive web design, and SEO best practices
  • Experience in a queue-based or production-oriented environment

Compensation

The approximate range for this role is $58,000 to $62,000, depending on experience and skills.

Benefits

Lumistry offers a comprehensive benefits package, including flexible time off; medical, dental, and vision coverage; long-term disability coverage; fitness benefits; and more.

Diversity and Inclusion at Lumistry

Lumistry is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to an inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment applies to every part of employment, from recruiting and hiring to compensation and promotion. We base our decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and current business needs.

Accessibility

We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. If you need assistance, please reach out.

We Do Consulting Differently


With teams of industry specialists and experts in forensic accounting and global investigations, discovery and forensic technology, M&A and private equity disputes, and cybersecurity and AI risk, BRG is a leader in the areas that can impact business most significantly.

With a multidisciplinary team of cybersecurity and AI risk specialists, our AI-native practice is at the forefront of enterprise resilience and safeguarding AI. We address the risks that matter most to boards, C-suites, and risk functions across financial services, technology, healthcare, and critical infrastructure.

Our practice is expanding, and we are seeking an experienced cybersecurity and AI risk Senior Managing Consultant with a strong track record leading complex advisory engagements across cybersecurity, technology risk, and emerging AI risk.

The Senior Managing Consultant will play a leading role in business development and the delivery of client engagements while contributing to practice growth. The role will involve leading multidisciplinary teams, developing trusted senior-client relationships, mentoring consulting staff, and helping shape BRG’s evolving cybersecurity & AI risk capabilities.

You will lead client engagements, mentor teams, and drive client impact across:

  • Cybersecurity and AI maturity assessments and strategic roadmaps, using leading frameworks including NIST, CIS and CRI
  • Cybersecurity strategy, operating models, and transformation programs
  • Cyber and AI risk governance, executive and board reporting
  • Third-party cyber and AI risk management
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams through complex cybersecurity and AI risk programs with accountability for scope, schedule, resources, quality, and client satisfaction
  • Cyber resilience, incident preparedness, and executive tabletop exercises
  • Cybersecurity and AI benchmarking assessments
  • Cyber risk quantification and business-impact analysis

Key responsibilities include:

  • Translate complex technical and risk findings into clear executive-level insights, business implications, and board-ready recommendations
  • Build and deepen client relationships through technical credibility and strategic thinking
  • Originate opportunities, contribute to proposals and pursuit activity, and developing proposals/SOWs, and contributing to revenue growth
  • Scope and shape new cybersecurity, technology risk and AI risk engagements in collaboration with Managing Directors and other BRG leaders
  • Mentor consulting staff and contribute to coaching and team development
  • Develop and industrialize repeatable client offerings, methodologies, accelerators and IP that can strengthen delivery and support business development

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Risk Management, or a related discipline
  • 7+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or enterprise risk consulting
  • Demonstrated experience leading consulting engagements or complex cybersecurity/risk programs
  • Demonstrated understanding of emerging AI governance, risk, and control requirements; experience designing or implementing AI governance or control frameworks e.g. NIST AI RMF, CRI FS AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 is preferred
  • Experience managing client relationships and communicating with senior executive stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks in business terms
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous issues, synthesize complex information, and develop practical recommendations

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or another relevant advanced security or risk certification
  • Experience within a Big 4 firm, specialist cybersecurity consultancy, or comparable advisory firm
  • Experience scoping and proposing cybersecurity and AI risk engagements with demonstrated contribution to business development and sales
  • Track record of delivering enterprise cybersecurity transformations, large-scale governance programs, or risk-management implementations
  • Experience presenting cybersecurity or technology-risk issues to executive leadership and boards/board committees

Salary Range: $170,000 – $200,000 per year. Bonus Eligible.


Candidate must be able to submit verification of his/her legal right to work in the U.S. or Canada, without company sponsorship.



About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.


BRG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our hiring practices provide equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender, national origin, age, United States military veteran status, ancestry, sexual orientation, marital status, family structure, medical condition including genetic characteristics or information, veteran status, or mental or physical disability so long as the essential functions of the job can be performed with or without reasonable accommodation, or any other protected category under federal, state, or local law.

Position: Software Engineer, (EMW)

Reports To: Director of Business Systems

Epoch Concepts LLC (Epoch) has been providing Market Research, Enterprise IT, and Cyber Security Solutions and Services to both commercial and government clients since 2006.

We are a value-added reseller focused on overcoming organizational challenges with solutions that don’t just address problems but also create opportunities and competitive advantages. Our core capabilities cover three major areas: Services, Solutions, and Integrations.

Based in Littleton, CO, Epoch works closely with industry leaders such as Cisco, HPE, Dell Technologies, Netscout, and Palo Alto, focusing on Federal Systems Integrators, USG, and Commercial Communities. Because of our strategic alliance with key distribution channels, Epoch is able to offer our customers access to over 2500 vendors. As a certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), Epoch is a valuable sole source provider of technology products and services. Our employees are our greatest assets, and we take pride in recognizing their outstanding talents and efforts.

Position Summary:

Epoch Modern Workflow (EMW) is Epoch's platform for turning manual, spreadsheet-driven business processes into purpose-built applications. The initiative now includes more than 85 applications spanning vendor management, event management, invoice automation, and asset management, all built through AI-assisted development and maintained from a shared template so every improvement reaches every app. EMW serves two audiences: commercial and federal customers who deploy it for their own operations, and Epoch’s internal staff who use it to build internal workflow tools.

This role supports both audiences. You will extend and support EMW applications delivered to customers, and you will mature the platform that lets non-developers across Epoch build software safely. The role entails: AI supported coding agents, designing agentic system guardrails, automation, and security foundation that let people build useful tools quickly without putting the company or its customers at risk.

Who you are:

  • Someone who cares more about the mission than the code. You measure your work by the value it delivers for the people using it.
  • A systems thinker who understands where components integrate, how they talk to each other, and where the gates need to be.
  • Security-minded by default, with instincts for secrets handling, authentication, input validation, and supply chain risk.
  • Comfortable working with AI coding agents.
  • Curious, adaptable, and willing to challenge your own habits as the tools and practices continue evolving.

What you’ll do:

  • Customer delivery: Support, configure, and extend EMW applications deployed for federal customers. Work alongside the team to understand customer requirements and translate them into features.
  • Platform engineering: Maintain and evolve the shared EMW application template, and carry changes across the full application fleet through continuous refactoring, including dependency and library changes, provider migrations, and framework updates.
  • Guardrails and security: Build and improve the controls that keep AI-assisted and citizen development safe, including secrets management, token issuance, authentication, CI/CD checks, and code review practices.
  • Automation: Automate build, test, deployment, and operational workflows so the platform scales without adding manual burden.
  • On-premises and classified deployment: Help bring EMW to on-premises environments at the Secret and Top Secret levels, including Linux hosting, hardening, and cross-domain considerations.
  • Product growth: Identify new capabilities that deliver value for federal customers, and help shape how EMW grows across additional Department of War organizations and agencies.

What qualifications you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in software development, DevSecOps, infrastructure automation, or systems engineering.
  • Strong Linux background including comfort working from the command line.
  • Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web frameworks.
  • Experience with scripting or programming in Python.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity practices such as vulnerability management, secrets handling, and authentication/authorization.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred:

  • Active U.S. Top Secret security clearance (SCI eligibility a plus) and able to maintain eligibility.
  • Experience with serverless or edge platforms and SQL databases.
  • Experience supporting Department of War or Intelligence Community mission environments, including classified networks.
  • Experience with cybersecurity zero trust architectures or identity providers.
  • Experience with DoD compliance frameworks (e.g., RMF, STIGs, CMMC).
  • Experience working directly with federal customers.
  • Experience with Linux and Docker development.

What We Offer:

  • Progressive Compensation Package
  • Healthcare Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drugs)
  • Wellness program
  • 401k with Company match
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 12 Paid Holidays
  • Life Insurance and Disability Coverage
  • On site gym (Littleton facility)
  • On-Going Training & Development

Our comprehensive, competitive benefits program is an important part of your total compensation package. We offer a variety of plans and coverage including health and welfare, retirement, unlimited PTO and voluntary benefits as well as resources to help you make cost-effective decisions for you and your family.

Due to the nature of our business, applicants must be United States citizens. All candidates are required to pass a background check and drug screening prior to employment.

Epoch Concepts participates in and maintains ISO certification. All employees are responsible for supporting our quality management system and continuous improvement efforts.

Epoch Concepts is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Description

About Quicklizard

Quicklizard helps retailers price with confidence. Our open, API‑first platform ingests transactions, inventory, and competitor feeds; combines rules with ML signals like elasticity, article segmentation, and competitor sensitivity; and uses a governed solver to recommend channel‑specific prices under clear guardrails. It’s transparent, Python‑extensible, and fast to adapt- so teams move from spreadsheets to omnichannel pricing that actually sticks. Every model output, rule, and recommendation is versioned and auditable, so buyers see how the price was made- and can adjust it without black‑box surprises.

The role

Be our senior, founding AE in LATAM and lead complex, multithreaded enterprise pursuits. You’ll define and work a named‑account plan, partner with SDRs for pipeline quality, and co‑create value cases that tie pricing decisions to margin protection, price perception, markdown efficiency, and e-commerce growth. You’ll run disciplined cycles from discovery to signature and keep a forecast executives can trust. You’ll also cultivate relationships with relevant partners/SIs and adjacent vendors where that accelerates access and implementation.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full cycle: discovery, solution design, executive workshops, business case, negotiation, and signature.
  • Build and work 30–50 named enterprise accounts; multithread across Pricing, Merchandising, Digital, IT, and Finance.
  • Drive evaluations with written success criteria and mutual action plans; navigate RFPs, security, procurement, and legal.
  • Coach SDRs on ICP and messaging; shape field campaigns with marketing; feed market signals back to product.
  • Maintain 3–4× coverage and stage hygiene in CRM; forecast accurately and call risks early.

What you bring (must have)

  • 5+ years closing complex B2B SaaS; repeated six‑figure ACVs in retail, pricing/promo, merchandising, or analytics.
  • Familiarity with pricing optimization, demand forecasting, and pricing strategies.
  • Access to Chief Merchant/Head of Pricing/C‑suite and comfort running top‑down and bottom‑up in parallel.
  • Strong discovery, value engineering, and executive communication; confident co‑presenting with solutions engineers/data scientists.
  • Experience shepherding RFPs, security reviews, and enterprise procurement.
  • North America–based; EST/CST preferred; 25- 40% travel.
  • Native Spanish | Portuguese - advantage

Nice to have

  • HubSpot/Salesforce familiarity
  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or other qualification methods.

Why Quicklizard?

Impact and autonomy in a role that opens the region. A product that proves value quickly and scales. A clear path into Strategic Accounts leadership as we grow.
